spells.name: 500 Toads
spells.notes: You conjure hundreds of magical toads to fill the area and hop around.

spells.name: Aberrant Form
spells.notes: Transform into an aberration battle form.

spells.name: Aberrant Whispers
spells.notes: You utter phrases in an unknown tongue, assaulting the minds of those nearby.

spells.name: Abyssal Plague
spells.notes: Inflict a draining curse.

spells.name: Accelerated Decomposition
spells.notes: You speed the natural process of a creature’s decline and debilitation.

spells.name: Access Lore
spells.notes: You sift through the multiverse's divine knowledge, seeking out tidbits related to a particular subject.

spells.name: Achaekek's Clutch
spells.notes: You mark the holy symbol of Achaekek in a visible location on the target’s body.

spells.name: Acid Grip
spells.notes: Move and harm foes with a hand of acid.

spells.name: Acid Storm
spells.notes: You evoke a storm of acid rain that pelts the area for the spell’s duration.

spells.name: Acidic Burst
spells.notes: You create a shell of acid around yourself that immediately bursts outward

spells.name: Adapt Self
spells.notes: You make subtle changes to your body to adapt to the situation.

spells.name: Adaptive Ablation
spells.notes: You shift yourself to adapt to the mystical wavelengths of the energy damage, protecting yourself from further harm.

spells.name: Admonishing Ray
spells.notes: A ray of energy bludgeons your target into submission without causing lasting harm.

spells.name: Advanced Scurvy
spells.notes: Your touch afflicts the target with an advanced form of scurvy, a mariner’s disease stemming from improper nutrition.

spells.name: Aerial Form
spells.notes: Turn into a flying combatant.

spells.name: Agile Feet
spells.notes: The blessings of your god make your feet faster and your movements more fluid.

spells.name: Agitate
spells.notes: You send the target’s mind and body into overdrive, forcing it to become restless and hyperactive.

spells.name: Agonizing Despair
spells.notes: Mentally damage and frighten a creature.

spells.name: Air Bubble
spells.notes: React to create air for a creature to breathe.

spells.name: Air Walk
spells.notes: Walk on air as though it were solid ground.

spells.name: Airburst
spells.target: all creatures and unattended objects in the area
spells.notes: A blast of wind wildly pushes everything nearby.

spells.name: Airlift
spells.notes: Fly creatures, and items to a new location.

spells.name: Alarm
spells.notes: Be alerted if a creature enters a warded area.

spells.name: Albatross Curse
spells.notes: You create a spectral albatross, a guiding bird for sailors, to hover around the target.

spells.name: All is One, One is All
spells.target: you and up to 10 willing living allies
spells.notes: You meld the targets' matter and life force into one and then, in an instant, sift them back out into their component selves.

spells.name: All-Encompassing Hunger
spells.notes: You reach out to devour a life, regardless of whether you need it for sustenance.

spells.name: Allegro
spells.notes: You perform rapidly, speeding up your ally.

spells.name: Allfood
spells.target: 1 unattended non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less
spells.notes: You transform one object into an edible substance that any living creature can chew, swallow, and safely digest.
spells.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

spells.name: Amalgamizing Leap
spells.notes: Teleport yourself and a foe into the same space, potentially fusing.

spells.name: Anathematic Reprisal
spells.notes: Cause mental pain to one who commits anathema against your deity.

spells.name: Ancestral Defense
spells.notes: Your ancestor protects you against those who would bend your will.

spells.name: Ancestral Form
spells.notes: You take the form of your ancestral spirits, becoming invisible and quasi-corporeal.

spells.name: Ancestral Memories
spells.notes: The memories of long-dead spellcasters grant you their knowledge, making your spells more formidable.

spells.name: Ancestral Touch
spells.notes: You touch a creature and force them to see and feel the ancestors surrounding you.

spells.name: Ancestral Winds
spells.notes: You call on the same energies that manifest ancestor storms, summoning wailing spirits to terrorize your foes.

spells.name: Anchoring Air
spells.notes: You solidify the air around an incoming attack, catching it in a vise-like grip

spells.name: Ancient Dust
spells.notes: You cough up a cloud of gray soil.

spells.name: Angel Form
spells.notes: Transform into an angel battle form.

spells.name: Angelic Halo
spells.notes: You gain an angelic halo with an aura that increases allies' healing from the heal spell.

spells.name: Angelic Wings
spells.notes: Wings of pure light spread out from your back, granting you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

spells.name: Animal Allies
spells.notes: Summon animals to briefly attack adjacent foes.

spells.name: Animal Feature
spells.notes: Without fully transforming your body, you gain one animalistic feature, which you select from the list below each time you Cast the Spell.

spells.name: Animal Form
spells.notes: Turn into a dangerous animal.

spells.name: Animal Messenger
spells.notes: Send a Tiny animal to deliver a message.

spells.name: Animal Vision
spells.notes: Project your senses through an animal.

spells.name: Animate Rope
spells.target: up to 50 feet of rope or a nonliving rope-like object
spells.notes: Command a rope to move and tie as you wish.

spells.name: Animated Assault
spells.notes: Temporarily animate small objects to attack.

spells.name: Animus Mine
spells.notes: You implant a mental mine within your psyche that detonates against anyone attempting to magically manipulate your thoughts.

spells.name: Annunciation of the Outer Gate
spells.notes: You announce yourself in the name of certain grim pacts that predate mortal life.

spells.name: Anointed Ground
spells.notes: Create a 24-hour area of protection against aberrations, celestials, dragons, fiends, monitors, or undead.

spells.name: Ant Haul
spells.notes: Target can carry more.

spells.name: Anticipate Peril
spells.notes: You grant the target brief foresight.

spells.name: Antimagic Field
spells.notes: Magic doesn't function in an area around you.

spells.name: Antlion Trap
spells.notes: You transmute the ground into a conical pit trap of loose sand that becomes difficult terrain for the duration.

spells.name: Apex Companion
spells.notes: Transform your animal companion into an apex form.

spells.name: Appeal to Authority
spells.notes: You implant a thought in your target’s mind that resembles an authority figure in their life, influencing how they feel about you.

spells.name: Appearance of Wealth
spells.notes: You create a brief vision of immense wealth filling the spell's area.

spells.name: Approximate
spells.notes: Magically estimate the number of nearby objects.

spells.name: Aqueous Blast
spells.notes: You evoke a mass of water into the air around your outstretched fist.

spells.name: Aqueous Orb
spells.notes: Roll a ball of water to put out fires and engulf creatures.

spells.name: Arcane Countermeasure
spells.target: the spell cast by the triggering creature
spells.notes: You undermine the target spell, making it easier to defend against.

spells.name: Arcane Explosion
spells.notes: Your body is temporarily converted into a ball of pure magic, rapidly exploding outward and reforming as a glowing sphere, after which you eventually regain your normal form.

spells.name: Arctic Rift
spells.notes: Bitter cold damages and freezes a creature.

spells.name: Armor of Bones
spells.notes: You ossify your physical form, mimicking the durability of bone.

spells.name: Armor of Thorn and Claw
spells.notes: Razor-sharp thorns and claws erupt from your skin or scales.

spells.name: Arms Of Nature
spells.target: wooden object or plant of at least 4 Bulk
spells.notes: All wood , dead or alive, is your armory.

spells.name: Aromatic Lure
spells.notes: You override a target's olfactory senses, luring them to a specific location through tantalizing false scents.

spells.name: Arrow Salvo
spells.notes: Fling massive arrows that can damage and knock down foes.

spells.name: Artistic Flourish
spells.target: 1 item or work of art that fits entirely within the range
spells.notes: You transform the target into a form that more closes matches your creative vision.

spells.name: Artistic Recollection
spells.notes: You create a temporary oil painting.

spells.name: Ash Cloud
spells.notes: Summon a cloud of hot ash and smoke.

spells.name: Ash Form
spells.notes: You take the form of a cloud of minuscule ash particles.

spells.name: Ashen Wind
spells.notes: You conjure a swirling wind of ashes that blows through the area.

spells.name: Asterism
spells.notes: Lines of burning starlight form a constellation around you.

spells.name: Astral Labyrinth
spells.notes: You connect the entire area with an invisible maze of astral energy that interferes with dimensional and mental magic.

spells.name: Astral Rain
spells.notes: You fling a mass of furious thoughts into the air, where they expand into numerous blades or other shapes that rain down.

spells.name: Athletic Rush
spells.notes: Your body fills with physical power and skill.

spells.name: Attacked From Within
spells.notes: You assert your power over the target’s own spirit as you reach deep into its soul in order to discover a moment of excruciating anguish, debilitating humiliation, or abject despair.

spells.name: Augmented Body
spells.notes: You magically augment your body with clockwork parts and magitech innovations.
spells.source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

spells.name: Augury
spells.notes: Predict whether a course of action brings good fortune.

spells.name: Aura of the Unremarkable
spells.notes: You and allies in the area appear to be completely innocuous to other creatures within the spell's area, regardless of the actions you're committing.

spells.name: Avatar
spells.notes: Transform into a battle form with benefits determined by your deity.

spells.name: Avenging Wildwood
spells.notes: Medium tree sprouts in an unoccupied square within range, its branches capable of striking out at your foes.

spells.name: Awaken Entropy
spells.notes: All things age, all things die, and at the end of days, even the universe will grow quiet and still.

spells.name: Bandit's Doom
spells.notes: Set up a ward to protect an item.

spells.name: Bane
spells.notes: Weaken enemies' attacks in an aura around you.

spells.name: Banishing Touch
spells.notes: Your touch projects a surge of magic that launches your target safely away.

spells.name: Banishment
spells.target: 1 creature that isn't on its home plane
spells.notes: Send a creature back to its home plane.

spells.name: Barbed Spear
spells.notes: You conjure a vicious barbed spear and hurl it at a foe.

spells.name: Battlefield Persistence
spells.notes: You're difficult to deter in battle.

spells.name: Beastmaster Trance
spells.target: one animal companion you can perceive
spells.notes: You enter a trance that allows you to see through the senses of the target companion.

spells.name: Bee-Man's Summons
spells.notes: You recreate the Bee-Man’s infamous ability to sense when someone utters their name.

spells.name: Befitting Attire
spells.notes: Make clothes fit the occasion.

spells.name: Befuddle
spells.notes: You sow seeds of confusion in your target’s mind.

spells.name: Begone
spells.notes: Launch an adjacent foe away.

spells.name: Beheading Buzz Saw
spells.notes: Lop heads off with a flying buzz saw.

spells.name: Behold the Weave
spells.notes: You behold the many timelines that weave around a creature, and in so doing, you make one more likely to occur.

spells.name: Belittling Boast
spells.notes: You boast about your skills or combat prowess, bolstering your own abilities and belittling your opponents.

spells.name: Benediction
spells.notes: Divine protection helps protect your companions.

spells.name: Beseech Arcanotheign
spells.notes: With a whispered prayer or arcane sending, you conjure Arcanotheign, herald of Nethys .

spells.name: Beseech the Sphinx
spells.notes: You look to the great Sphinx constellation, wisest of all cosmic guides and favored of Phimater, asking them to lend their insight to the target.

spells.name: Bestial Curse
spells.notes: Make a humanoid take on features of a beast.

spells.name: Bilocation
spells.notes: You exist in two places at once.

spells.name: Bind Heroic Spirit
spells.notes: You turn one of your thralls into a conduit to bind the spirit of a hero into your body.

spells.name: Bind Undead
spells.target: 1 mindless undead creature with a level no greater than bind undead ’s spell rank
spells.notes: Take control of a mindless undead.

spells.name: Binding Muzzle
spells.notes: A shimmering muzzle of pure magical force clamps the target's mouth shut.

spells.name: Bit of Luck
spells.notes: You tilt the scales of luck slightly to protect a creature from disaster.

spells.name: Biting Words
spells.notes: Hurl sonic taunts to hurt creatures.

spells.name: Blackfinger's Blades
spells.target: up to 4 weapons, each wielded by a separate willing creature within range
spells.notes: You pray for swift and painful death to your enemies and find your and your allies' weapons blessed to deliver just that.

spells.name: Blanket of Stars
spells.notes: A cloak of darkness hides you in the dark.

spells.name: Blast of the Bellows
spells.notes: You create a churning eddy of warm air that makes it difficult to fly within the area.

spells.name: Blastback
spells.notes: React to emit a shockwave when you land after a fall.

spells.name: Blazing Armory
spells.notes: Create a weapon made of fire.

spells.name: Blazing Blade
spells.notes: A scimitar-shaped beam of fiery light springs from your free hand.

spells.name: Blazing Bolt
spells.notes: Fire one to three flaming bolts at different foes.

spells.name: Blazing Dive
spells.notes: Fly up then dive in an explosion of fire.

spells.name: Blazing Fissure
spells.notes: Rip a crack of magma in the earth.

spells.name: Bless
spells.notes: Strengthen allies' attacks in an aura around you.

spells.name: Blessed Boundary
spells.notes: Manifest divine force in a protective sphere.

spells.name: Blessing of Defiance
spells.notes: Boost one of an ally’s defenses.

spells.name: Blessing of Vigor
spells.notes: Grant an ally the gift of rapid healing.

spells.name: Blightburn Blast
spells.notes: Inflict a creature with blightburn sickness.
spells.source: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands

spells.name: Blind Eye
spells.notes: You enchant a single object, preventing it from being used for magical observation.

spells.name: Blinding Beauty
spells.notes: You channel the allure of your nymph bloodline into a terribly beautiful glance.

spells.name: Blinding Bottle
spells.notes: You conjure an exploding glass container filled with a sightstealing poison and hurl it across enemy lines.

spells.name: Blinding Foam
spells.notes: You spray a colorful, caustic foam into the target's eyes, which clings to their face.

spells.name: Blinding Fury
spells.notes: Curse a creature to be unable to see its victims.

spells.name: Blindness
spells.notes: Strike a target blind.

spells.name: Blink Charge
spells.notes: Teleport and attack with magical force.

spells.name: Blister
spells.notes: Grow blisters on a creature and pop them to spray acid.

spells.name: Blister Bomb
spells.notes: You launch a small bomb enchanted with a fast-acting skin disease at your foes, causing their skin to break out in horrible bleeding sores.

spells.name: Blistering Invective
spells.notes: Light a creature on fire with harsh words.

spells.name: Blood Chestnuts
spells.notes: You plant a draining seed inside of an opponent.

spells.name: Blood Duplicate
spells.target: 1 non- magical object of 1 Bulk or less
spells.notes: This spell deals you 1 piercing damage as you shape a magical duplicate of the target from your blood; you can't cast this spell if you don't have blood.

spells.name: Blood Feast
spells.notes: Your head splits vertically into an enormous maw, which feasts upon the target's blood.

spells.name: Blood in the Water
spells.notes: Predators are drawn to the scent of blood, and blood can disperse shockingly far in the water.

spells.name: Blood Infusion
spells.notes: You pull blood and other fluid from a thrall before embedding it into another creature.

spells.name: Blood Runs Cold
spells.notes: Slowly begin to freeze an opponent’s blood.

spells.name: Blood Vendetta
spells.notes: Cause a creature that attacks you to start bleeding.

spells.name: Blood Ward
spells.notes: Your patron's aegis descends to shield a target from harm.

spells.name: Blood-Feasting Breath
spells.notes: Like a vorpal dragon, you absorb life with an inhale and release it with an exhale.

spells.name: Bloodspray Curse
spells.notes: Curse a foe with deeper wounds and bleeding.

spells.name: Bloody Tendrils
spells.notes: You conjure forth stationary tentacles formed from pure, partially hardened blood.

spells.name: Blossoming Gore
spells.notes: By spilling the blood of a thrall, you grow a large field of bloody roses that feeds on the life force of those around it and uses it to create thralls that do your bidding.

spells.name: Blur
spells.notes: Target's form becomes blurry and hard to hit.

spells.name: Boil Blood
spells.notes: Boil a foe's blood.

spells.name: Bone Flense
spells.target: 1 weapon that is either wielded by a member of the Red Mantis or is a praying mantis’s leg Strike
spells.notes: The target weapon becomes imbued with Achaekek’s power

spells.name: Bone Moth's Kiss
spells.target: 1 creature with bones or a natural exoskeleton
spells.notes: You send a disease-ridden moth to infect an opponent.

spells.name: Bone Shield
spells.notes: Create a bony shield.

spells.name: Bone Spear
spells.notes: You shape a thrall into a spear of jagged bone.

spells.name: Bone Spray
spells.notes: Launch a flurry of jagged bones.

spells.name: Boneshaker
spells.notes: You reach out a hand and seize a creature's skeleton from afar, harming their body and potentially wrenching them by the bones to move them against their will.

spells.name: Bonewall Bulwark
spells.notes: You create a miniature replica of the infamouse Bonewall of Yled.

spells.name: Bony Barrage
spells.notes: You shatter the skeleton of a thrall, creating a volley of teeth, vertebrae, and phalanges.

spells.name: Boomerang Shot
spells.notes: You launch a curved length of wood at a foe that arcs around objects and obstacles to strike from an unexpected direction.

spells.name: Booming Blast
spells.notes: Frighten your opponents with a terrifying gunshot.

spells.name: Boost Eidolon
spells.notes: You focus deeply on the link between you and your eidolon and boost the power of your eidolon’s attacks.

spells.name: Boots on the Ground
spells.notes: You craft the illusion of your army being much bigger than it actually is, hoping to overwhelm the opposing forces and shatter their hopes.

spells.name: Bottle the Storm
spells.notes: When lightning is turned against you, you store the charge safely within yourself, unleashing it when the time is right.

spells.name: Bottomless Stomach
spells.notes: Store things in a creature’s stomach.

spells.name: Bound in Death
spells.notes: You tether another creature's spirit to your own, shunting part of the damage dealt to you onto one of your foes.

spells.name: Bounty of The Sky
spells.notes: You call forth a flock of geese that drop restorative fruits and breads from the sky as they fly overhead.

spells.name: Bracing Tendrils
spells.notes: Visible tendrils of force anchor your body to the ground, preventing unwanted movement.

spells.name: Brain Drain
spells.notes: You probe the target's mind to glean knowledge.

spells.name: Bralani Referendum
spells.notes: You enforce fair play with punishing zephyrs.

spells.name: Bramble Bush
spells.notes: In a sudden burst of growth, you cause a thorned bush to sprout from the ground, lash around, and wither.

spells.name: Brand the Impenitent
spells.notes: You brand the target with an ethereal copy of your deity’s religious symbol.

spells.name: Breadcrumbs
spells.notes: Make a trail behind a creature.

spells.name: Breath of Drought
spells.notes: You fill the area with an oppressive, arid swelter that overwhelms creatures with heat exhaustion.
spells.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.notes: React to revive a character at the moment of its death.

spells.name: Breathe Fire
spells.notes: Release a small cone of flame from your mouth.

spells.name: Bridge of Graves
spells.notes: You summon a bridge formed from grave dirt and tombstones that allow thralls to move with great speed.

spells.name: Bridge of Vines
spells.notes: Vines sprout beneath your feet and extend away from you in a straight line.

spells.name: Brine Dragon Bile
spells.notes: React to spit saltwater into a cut.

spells.name: Briny Bolt
spells.notes: You hurl a bolt of salt water from your extended hand.

spells.name: Buffeting Winds
spells.notes: You release a quick burst of wind that batters your living opponents without causing them lasting harm, while also blowing undead away.

spells.name: Bullhorn
spells.notes: Magnify your voice to be heard at a distance.

spells.name: Buoyant Bubbles
spells.notes: Create bubbles that make a creature buoyant.

spells.name: Burglar's Blind
spells.notes: The only thing thieves love more than being silent and stealthy is the piles of gold they win with that silence and stealth.

spells.name: Burning Blossoms
spells.notes: A tree fascinates enemies and burns people.

spells.name: Burning Trail
spells.notes: Your companion or eidolon leaves a fiery trail as they move.

spells.name: Burrow Ward
spells.notes: Prevent burrowing in earth near you.

spells.name: Bursting Bloom
spells.notes: You cause a rose bush to sprout from the chest of a foe, bursting out of its body and wrapping it in thorned vines.

spells.name: Buzzing Bites
spells.notes: You evoke buzzing and crawling insects to climb onto a foe’s body and bite, dealing 1d4 piercing damage and potentially sickening the foe, depending on its Fortitude save.

spells.name: Buzzing Servants
spells.notes: You summon a swarm of bees from the city of Axis that rapidly constructs geometric shapes from wax.

spells.name: Cackle
spells.notes: With a quick burst of laughter, you prolong a magical effect you created.

spells.name: Calcification
spells.notes: You transform a thrall into fine dust particles that invade a creature’s body and begin transforming their body into a statue made of pure enhanced bone.

spells.name: Calcium Rain
spells.notes: Sharpened bones rain down from the sky.

spells.name: Call Fluxwraith
spells.notes: You break a mirror and cast the shards into the air.

spells.name: Call of the Quenching
spells.notes: Legends say Aroden and Arazni called upon the Boundless Sea itself to defeat the fiery lizard Cuetzmonquali and the Army of Fire.

spells.name: Call the Blood
spells.notes: With a word and gesture, you cause streams of blood to erupt from the target's mouth, nostrils, ears, or other facial openings and come rushing into your mouth.

spells.name: Call the Ten
spells.notes: The Ten Magic Warriors were the first of the Magaambya’s students, and they come to your aid even now.

spells.name: Call to Arms
spells.notes: You cry out a call to arms, inspiring your allies to enter the fray.

spells.name: Calm
spells.notes: Suppress strong emotions and hostility.

spells.name: Camel Spit
spells.notes: You alter your stomach, esophagus, and tongue to be able to spit partially digested food with force.

spells.name: Canopy Crawler
spells.notes: The target grows a prehensile tail, or gains prehensile qualities in their existing tail, to help them climb with ease.

spells.name: Canticle of Everlasting Grief
spells.notes: Sing a mournful dirge that frightens and mentally damages a foe, preventing its bonuses.

spells.name: Capital Dividend
spells.notes: Through diet and other strict regimens, you’ve fortified your body as Kalistrade’s teachings have fortified your mind.

spells.name: Captivating Adoration
spells.notes: You become intensely entrancing, and creatures are distracted by you as long as they remain within the area.

spells.name: Carrion Mire
spells.notes: The ground opens into a seemingly endless mass of corpse limbs.

spells.name: Carryall
spells.notes: A floating platform follows you, carrying objects.

spells.name: Cascade Countermeasure
spells.notes: You quickly adjust your Arcane Cascade to offer magical protection.

spells.name: Cast into Time
spells.notes: Force a creature to fall through time.

spells.name: Caster's Imposition
spells.notes: A magical interference prevents the target from contributing to any form of cooperative spellcasting.

spells.name: Cataclysm
spells.notes: Call an instant, devastating cataclysm.

spells.name: Catch Your Name
spells.notes: You learn a private name (but not the true name) of the creature who spoke your name, as well as their precise location, unless they succeed at a Will save to negate the effect.

spells.name: Caustic Blast
spells.notes: Fling a glob of acid that splashes a small area.

spells.name: Cauterize Wounds
spells.notes: Seal bleeding wounds with flame.

spells.name: Cave Fangs
spells.notes: Make flowstone spikes bite creatures and impede movement.

spells.name: Celestial Accord
spells.target: 2 creatures that each have an unfriendly or worse attitude toward the other
spells.notes: You intervene in a heated disagreement between two creatures, encouraging them to put aside their differences and find some common ground.

spells.name: Celestial Brand
spells.notes: A blazing symbol appears on the target, cursing it to face divine justice.

spells.name: Censure Falsehoods
spells.notes: You call on your patron to reprimand a creature that has attempted a Deception or Stealth check against you.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.target: 1 creature, plus any number of additional creatures
spells.notes: An arc of lightning jumps from creature to creature.

spells.name: Chameleon Coat
spells.notes: Camouflage creatures to their environment.

spells.name: Champion's Sacrifice
spells.notes: You form a link with an ally, allowing you to take harm in their stead.

spells.name: Channel Arrogance
spells.notes: You channel your heightened sense of self-worth into a creature, forcing them to acknowledge your true worth.

spells.name: Charged Javelin
spells.notes: You fire a javelin of electricity that leaves a charged field around its target.

spells.name: Charitable Urge
spells.notes: Make a creature give away an object.

spells.name: Charm
spells.notes: A creature becomes more friendly to you.

spells.name: Charming Push
spells.notes: You push at the target's mind to deflect their ire.

spells.name: Charming Touch
spells.target: 1 creature that could find you attractive
spells.notes: You infuse your target with attraction, causing it to act friendlier toward you.

spells.name: Chastising Retort
spells.notes: You unleash some choice words empowered with divine might.

spells.name: Chilling Darkness
spells.notes: Ray of unholy darkness deals cold damage, dispels light, and harms holy targets.

spells.name: Chilling Spray
spells.notes: Icy shards fly out from you in a cone.

spells.name: Chosen Gravity
spells.notes: Alter gravity to allow the target to walk on walls and ceilings.

spells.name: Chroma Leach
spells.notes: Sap the color and vitality from a living creature.

spells.name: Chromatic Armor

spells.name: Chromatic Image
spells.notes: Colorful mirror images damage foes who destroy them.

spells.name: Chromatic Ray
spells.notes: Ray of light causes effects based on its color.

spells.name: Chromatic Wall
spells.notes: A wall of light offers a unique protection based on its color.

spells.name: Chrysopoetic Curse
spells.notes: You grant the target the gift of riches, giving them the power to turn anything they touch to gold

spells.name: Chthonian Wrath
spells.notes: You evoke the energy of a part of the Outer Rifts.

spells.name: Cinder Gaze
spells.notes: You've learned to read the future in the patterns of flames and smoke.

spells.name: Cinder Scribe
spells.notes: Scribe a note that is only revealed with heat.

spells.name: Cinder Swarm
spells.notes: Create insects made of fire.

spells.name: Circle of Protection
spells.notes: A creature emits an aura that protects those within against an alignment.

spells.name: Circle of Weakness
spells.notes: You evoke a circle of floating inscriptions that creates and amplifies energy-based weaknesses on creatures inside the circle.

spells.name: Clad in Metal
spells.target: 1 metal object of 5 Bulk or less that's unattended or attended by a willing creature
spells.notes: Coat an item in a metal of your choice.

spells.name: Claim Curse
spells.notes: Draw a creature’s curse into you temporarily.

spells.name: Claim Undead
spells.notes: You attempt to wrest control of a target undead or force it to recognize you as its master.

spells.name: Clairaudience
spells.notes: Hear through an invisible magical sensor.

spells.name: Clairvoyance
spells.notes: See through an invisible magical sensor.

spells.name: Claws of the Otter
spells.notes: Webbing grows between your fingers and your nails extend into vicious claws.

spells.name: Clawsong
spells.target: 1 willing creature with an unarmed claw Strike
spells.notes: You sing a fierce prayer, low and growling, and awaken the ancient spirit of a Terwa beast to guide and strengthen the target's unarmed blows.

spells.name: Cleanse Affliction
spells.notes: Treat a curse, disease, or poison.

spells.name: Cleanse Air
spells.notes: Make air safe.

spells.name: Cleanse Cuisine
spells.notes: Make food and drink safe and delicious.

spells.name: Cleansing Flames
spells.notes: You wrap the target in purifying flames.

spells.name: Clear Mind
spells.notes: Counteract fleeing, frightened, stupefied, and related conditions.

spells.name: Clinging Ice
spells.notes: Freezing sleet and heavy snowfall collect on the target's feet and legs, dealing 1d4 cold damage and other effects depending on its Reflex save.

spells.name: Clinging Shadows Stance
spells.notes: You adopt the stance of clinging shadows.

spells.name: Cloak of Colors
spells.notes: Bright colors dazzle and blind creatures.

spells.name: Cloak of Light
spells.notes: You surround yourself in holy light that restores the living and rebuffs undead.

spells.name: Cloak of Shadow
spells.notes: You drape the target in a mantle of swirling shadows that make it harder to see.

spells.name: Clockwork Devotion
spells.notes: You toss a handful of magical cogs before you, summoning a battalion of clockwork soldiers to fight your enemies.

spells.name: Clone Companion
spells.notes: Create a duplicate animal companion that mirrors your companion’s actions.

spells.name: Cloud Current
spells.notes: Air and water vapor combine into a great cloud that funnels a powerful current within it.

spells.name: Cloud Dragon's Cloak
spells.target: the creature targeted by the attack
spells.notes: React to hide a creature in mist.

spells.name: Clouded Focus
spells.notes: You sharpen a creature’s senses, though more distant objects become hazy, indistinct, or muted to it.

spells.name: Clownish Curse
spells.notes: You afflict the target with a curse that causes it to emit ridiculous noises as it moves.
spells.source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

spells.name: Coiling Dance
spells.notes: You perform a dance that seeks to pass on the knowledge and wisdom of a naga.

spells.name: Collective Transposition
spells.notes: Teleport up to two creatures to new positions near you.

spells.name: Combustion
spells.notes: You ignite a creature in lasting flames.
spells.source: Rage of Elements, Secrets of Magic

spells.name: Comet Charge
spells.notes: Launch yourself before delivering a massive blow.

spells.name: Command
spells.notes: Bid a creature approach, run, drop something, lie prone, or stand up.

spells.name: Commanding Lash
spells.target: a creature you dealt damage to on your most recent action
spells.notes: With the threat of more pain, you compel a creature you've recently harmed.

spells.name: Community Restoration
spells.notes: When you use your magic to support your allies, shared strength bolsters you all.

spells.name: Companion's Shadow
spells.notes: Your companion’s shadow helps them fight.

spells.name: Compel True Name
spells.target: 1 creature whose true name you know
spells.notes: You instruct the target to do something, compelling obedience by calling it by its true name.

spells.name: Competitive Edge
spells.notes: Your competitiveness drives you to prove yourself against the opposition.

spells.name: Concordant Choir
spells.notes: Damage foes with music.

spells.name: Conductive Weapon
spells.target: 1 metal weapon that is unattended or attended by a willing creature
spells.notes: Charge a metal weapon with electricity.

spells.name: Confetti Cloud
spells.notes: You conjure a dense storm of swirling confetti.

spells.name: Confront Selves
spells.notes: You show the target the spiraling web of actions and consequences that is their life and the changes wrought by these decisions upon themselves and those around them.

spells.name: Confusing Colors
spells.notes: Dazzle, confuse, or stun creatures in a cloud.

spells.name: Confusing Cry
spells.notes: You give an unsettling, warbling cry that causes nearby creatures to lash out without control.

spells.name: Confusion
spells.notes: Befuddle a creature, making it act randomly.

spells.name: Conglomerate of Limbs
spells.notes: You conjure forth a humongous thrall consisting solely of undead severed limbs.

spells.name: Conjured Clockwork
spells.notes: You conjure a complex clockwork device on the ground and cause it to slowly spread across the battlefield.
spells.source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

spells.name: Conjured Conveyance
spells.notes: You conjure an intricate vehicle, carved entirely from wood, to serve as a method of conveyance.

spells.name: Conjurer's Countermeasure
spells.notes: You quickly create a barrier that protects you against the magic of spellcraft.

spells.name: Connective Current
spells.notes: You create a magical connection between you and an enemy, as if you were both caught in the same current.

spells.name: Conquering Soldiers
spells.notes: You tap into the glories of the armies of old, bringing forth their might to your battlefield and making their strength and power your own.

spells.name: Consecrate Flesh
spells.notes: Through the strength of your faith, your body becomes infused with holy energy.

spells.name: Consuming Darkness
spells.notes: Your shadow wriggles before spreading out from you, forming a gateway of clinging, consuming shadow through which the horrors of another plane can barely be seen.

spells.name: Contagious Idea
spells.target: 1 or 2 creatures other than yourself (see text)
spells.notes: You place either a pleasant thought or a terrifying one in a creature's mind

spells.name: Containment
spells.notes: Seal a creature in a sphere to contain or protect it.

spells.name: Contingency
spells.notes: Set up a spell to trigger later under your choice of circumstances.

spells.name: Control Sand
spells.notes: Manipulate sand around you.
spells.source: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands

spells.name: Control Water
spells.notes: Raise or lower water in a large area.

spells.name: Coral Eruption
spells.notes: Create damaging areas of razor-sharp coral.

spells.name: Coral Scourge
spells.notes: Fill a creature’s joints with stiffening coral growths.

spells.name: Cordyceps Command
spells.notes: You conjure a mote of cordyceps spores uniquely tailored to the target before whisking it at them.

spells.name: Cornucopia
spells.notes: Vines twine into a wicker horn in your hands, and out spills a single fruit, nut, or similar small bit of produce.

spells.name: Corpse Bloom
spells.notes: Conjure clusters of poisonous fungi.

spells.name: Corrosive Body
spells.notes: Turn your body into living acid.

spells.name: Corrosive Muck
spells.notes: Create two puddles of acidic slime.

spells.name: Cosmic Form
spells.notes: Turn into a battle form based on the sun or moon.

spells.name: Counter Performance
spells.notes: Your performance protects you and your allies.

spells.name: Countless Eyes
spells.notes: Spawn magical eyes all over a creature’s body.

spells.name: Courageous Anthem
spells.notes: You inspire yourself and your allies with words or tunes of encouragement.

spells.name: Cozy Cabin

spells.name: Cradle Aloft
spells.target: 1 held object of 2 Bulk or less
spells.notes: Cause an item to float by your side.

spells.name: Crashing Wave
spells.notes: Smash a cone of water against foes.

spells.name: Create Earthen Facsimile
spells.notes: Facsimile Mold earth into a simple form.

spells.name: Create Food
spells.notes: Feed multiple creatures with conjured food.

spells.name: Create Thrall
spells.notes: You conjure forth the undead.

spells.name: Create Water
spells.notes: Conjure 2 gallons of water.

spells.name: Creation
spells.notes: Make a temporary object.

spells.name: Creative Splash
spells.notes: A deluge of paint or colorful illusions descend on the area, reflecting your personal creative specialty.

spells.name: Crescent Scepter
spells.notes: You hold up any object, which takes on the appearance of glowing regalia in the eyes of those who look on you.

spells.name: Crimson Breath
spells.notes: You turn a creature toward you and exhale a blast of crimson mist from your mouth

spells.name: Crisis of Faith
spells.notes: Cause mental damage and possibly make a worshiper unable to cast spells.

spells.name: Croak Voice
spells.notes: You cause the target creature’s vocal chords to swell like those of a frog.

spells.name: Crown of Prophets
spells.notes: Serpents sprout from your head, equally ready to bite your foes or offer you counsel.

spells.name: Crucible of Iron
spells.notes: Encase a creature in molten iron.

spells.name: Crusade
spells.notes: Creatures become dedicated to a cause of your choice.

spells.name: Crushing Ground
spells.notes: You tear open the ground then slam it shut.
spells.source: Rage of Elements, Secrets of Magic

spells.name: Cry of Destruction
spells.notes: Your voice booms, smashing what's in front of you.

spells.name: Cryostasis
spells.notes: Protect a dying creature by encasing them in ice.

spells.name: Crystallized Vapors
spells.notes: Turn water vapor into many frozen attacks.

spells.name: Cup of Dust
spells.notes: You curse the target with a thirst no drink can quench.

spells.name: Curse of Death
spells.notes: Your patron wraps a hand around your target's heart.

spells.name: Curse of Lost Time
spells.target: 1 Large or smaller object, construct , or living creature
spells.notes: Artificially erode or age a target.

spells.name: Curse of Recoil
spells.notes: You curse an enemy to suffer a kickback as they make a ranged attack, potentially causing them to miss.

spells.name: Curse of the Spirit Orchestra
spells.notes: You summon an invisible, insubstantial group of extraplanar musicians who follow the target and play distracting music to hinder its actions.

spells.name: Cursed Metamorphosis
spells.notes: Transform the target into a harmless animal.

spells.name: Cutting Eye
spells.notes: Your eyes open enviously, stealing the power of an opponent for yourself.

spells.name: Cutting Insult
spells.notes: You utter an insult so offensive that it cuts your target to the quick.

spells.name: Cycle of Retribution
spells.notes: An understanding of how violence begets more violence fills your target, causing it mental anguish in the form of splitting headaches when it attempts to take violent actions.

spells.name: Cyclone Rondo
spells.notes: Playing or singing melodies discovered by the ancient Shory, you call up a whirlwind

spells.name: Daemon Form
spells.notes: Turn into a daemon battle form.

spells.name: Dance of Darkness
spells.notes: You dance, Striding up to half your Speed.

spells.name: Dancing Blade
spells.notes: You telekinetically animate a weapon that’s unattended or on your person.

spells.name: Dancing Fountain
spells.notes: Tap a splendid fountain with majestic displays you command.

spells.target: 1 touched shield (unattended or in your possession) and 1 willing creature
spells.notes: You levitate the touched shield and send it to orbit around a creature.

spells.name: Darkened Forest Form
spells.notes: Your apparition casts a feral shadow over your form.

spells.name: Darkened Sight
spells.notes: You infuse a creature's vision with darkness.

spells.name: Darklight
spells.notes: Shadows pour forth from your eyes, creating a field of darkness that prevents light from emanating within the area.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.notes: Suppress all light in an area.

spells.name: Darkvision
spells.notes: See in the dark.

spells.name: Dawnflower's Light
spells.target: 1 unattended, non- magical object of 1 Bulk or less
spells.notes: The object glows with soft golden light that lays bare the truth, reveals hidden objects, and shines supernatural light on false orders.

spells.name: Day's Weight
spells.notes: Use time magic to fatigue a creature.

spells.name: Daydreamer's Curse
spells.notes: You impose a curse upon the target that renders it easily distracted and unable to focus its thoughts on tasks that demand insight or discernment.

spells.name: Daze
spells.notes: Cloud a creature's mind and possibly stun it.

spells.name: Dazzling Flash
spells.notes: You raise your religious symbol and create a blinding flash of light.

spells.name: Dead Weight
spells.notes: You command a thrall to hurl itself on another creature, fusing their flesh together.

spells.name: Deafness

spells.notes: Protect a creature against negative energy.

spells.notes: Seeing another pass from this world invigorates you.

spells.name: Deathless March

spells.name: Deathly Scream
spells.notes: Your thrall lets forth a spectral scream that pierces the mind.

spells.notes: You reveal a glimpse of the impossible conflicts between the divine anathema behind your curse, forcing you to reckon with another's conflicts as well.

spells.name: Debilitating Terror
spells.notes: You fill the target’s mind with terrifying images to disrupt their combat focus.

spells.name: Decompose
spells.notes: Speed up the decaying process of a corpse.

spells.name: Deep Breath

spells.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

spells.notes: Twist fate to protect your familiar.

spells.name: Defy the Gods
spells.notes: Drain away a creature’s divine spark.

spells.name: Dehydrate

spells.name: Deity's Strike
spells.notes: Enormous deific weapon falls onto a foe from the sky.

spells.name: Demon Form
spells.notes: Turn into a demon battle form.

spells.name: Desiccate
spells.notes: Pull moisture from creatures, damaging them.

spells.notes: You hold a shield together with the power of your magic, forcing wood and steel to fuse back together.

spells.name: Destructive Aura
spells.notes: Swirling sands of divine devastation surround you, weakening the defenses of all they touch.

spells.name: Detect Alignment
spells.notes: See auras of a chosen alignment.

spells.name: Detect Creator
spells.notes: You examine the remains or spiritual residue of a destroyed undead creature to locate that undead's creator, perhaps a necromancer or vampire.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.notes: Sense whether magic is nearby.

spells.name: Detect Metal
spells.notes: Sense whether metal is nearby.

spells.name: Detect Poison
spells.notes: Determine whether an object or creature is poisonous or venomous.

spells.name: Detect Scrying
spells.notes: Find out whether scrying effects are in the area.

spells.notes: Cause a spell or item to explode.

spells.name: Devil Form
spells.notes: Turn into a devil battle form.

spells.notes: Your apparition's dark power blends with your physical body, allowing you to take on terrifying characteristics of creatures that lurk in dark places.

spells.name: Dimensional Drop
spells.notes: Force an enemy to fall through a portal.

spells.name: Dinosaur Form
spells.notes: Turn into a dinosaur.

spells.name: Dinosaur Fort

spells.name: Dirge of Doom
spells.notes: Enemies within the area are frightened 1 .

spells.name: Dirge of Remembrance
spells.notes: You sing a funereal dirge to force restless spirits to fully manifest in the Material Plane .

spells.notes: Make a creature invisible, silent, and undetectable by special senses.

spells.name: Discern Lies
spells.notes: Expertly detect lies and falsehoods.

spells.name: Discern Secrets
spells.notes: Your patron deigns to whisper a few secrets.

spells.name: Discomfiting Whisper
spells.notes: You are surrounded by an aura of spiteful murmurings that incite bad luck and punish failure.

spells.name: Disguise Magic
spells.notes: Mask the aura of a spell or item.

spells.name: Disintegrating Puddle
spells.notes: Spit an acid puddle at a creature.

spells.name: Dismantle

spells.name: Disorienting Flash

spells.name: Dispelling Globe
spells.notes: Counteract magic that enters this sphere.

spells.name: Disruptive Transfer

spells.notes: You create a magical lens that distorts space as best suits you.

spells.name: Distracting Chatter
spells.notes: Distract a creature with auditory illusions.

spells.name: Dive and Breach
spells.notes: Teleport with splashes of water.

spells.name: Divine Armageddon
spells.notes: Call on your deity to bring about a cataclysm.

spells.name: Divine Aura
spells.notes: Allies in an aura have better defenses and are protected against one alignment.

spells.name: Divine Decree
spells.notes: Creatures opposing your deity's will are damaged, enfeebled, or banished.

spells.name: Divine Immolation
spells.notes: Call divine fire from the sky.

spells.name: Divine Inspiration

spells.name: Divine Lance
spells.notes: Throw divine energy that deals spirit damage.

spells.name: Divine Plagues
spells.notes: Your deity sends wracking plagues.

spells.name: Divine Vessel
spells.notes: Take on aspects of a servitor of your deity.

spells.name: Divine Wrath
spells.notes: Damage and hinder creatures opposing your deity's will.

spells.name: Diviner's Sight

spells.name: Dizzying Colors

spells.name: Dome of Tranquility
spells.notes: Create a safe area for secrets.

spells.name: Doom Mark

spells.name: Downpour
spells.notes: You call forth a torrential downpour, which extinguishes non-magical flames.

spells.notes: You shape energy into a small group of tiny dragons (or other serpentine creatures) that flit around you.

spells.name: Dragon Claws

spells.notes: Turn into a dragon.

spells.notes: Mentally sting a creature's mind to make it less capable of attacking creatures other than you.

spells.name: Draw Moisture

spells.name: Dread Aura
spells.notes: You emit an aura of terror.

spells.notes: You utter a powerful secret at odds with the fundamental nature of the target creatures.

spells.notes: Communicate through a shared dream.

spells.name: Dream Message
spells.target: 1 creature you know by name and have met in person
spells.notes: Send a message that arrives in a dream.

spells.name: Dreamer's Call
spells.notes: You create a vivid, illusory daydream drawn from the images of the target's dreams.

spells.name: Dreaming Potential
spells.notes: The target retrains in its dreams.
