spells.notes: With a ripple of earth, you raise small barriers from the ground.

spells.name: Eat Fire
spells.notes: React to eat flame then belch the smoke out.

spells.name: Echo Jump
spells.notes: You teleport to an unoccupied space within range, leaving behind a faint echo of your form that explodes with magical force.

spells.name: Echoing Weapon
spells.notes: Your attacks build up to release a sonic pulse.

spells.name: Eclipse Burst
spells.notes: Explode a globe of darkness that deals cold damage, hurts the living, and overcomes light.

spells.name: Ectoplasmic Expulsion
spells.notes: You call upon tendrils of ephemeral ectoplasm to pass through the target and carry away a harmful psychic affliction.

spells.name: Ectoplasmic Interstice
spells.notes: You force the mortal Universe and Ethereal Planes to partially merge, creating a zone that causes incorporeal and spiritual entities to take on many of the aspects of corporeal creatures.

spells.name: Efficient Apport
spells.target: 1 unattended object of light Bulk or less
spells.notes: Walking over to an item to pick it up is so much effort.

spells.name: Eidolon's Wrath
spells.notes: Your eidolon releases a powerful explosion of energy that deals 5d6 damage of the type you chose when you took the Eidolon’s Wrath feat, with a basic Reflex save.

spells.name: Eject Soul
spells.target: 1 living creature that has a soul
spells.notes: Your touch disrupts the connection between body and soul, possibly forcing the soul out of the body altogether.

spells.name: Electric Arc
spells.notes: Zap one or two creatures with lightning.

spells.name: Electrified Crystal Ward
spells.notes: You create an electric latch rune hazard on the target, creating a special crystalline lock on the object.
spells.source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

spells.name: Electrostatic Glider
spells.notes: Use static electricity to glide.

spells.name: Element Embodied
spells.notes: Turn into a massive elemental.

spells.name: Elemental Absorption
spells.notes: Resist elemental effects and then release the energy against a foe.

spells.name: Elemental Annihilation Wave
spells.notes: Draw in elemental energy to unleash a cone of burning destruction.

spells.name: Elemental Betrayal
spells.notes: Your patron uses its superior command of the elements, empowering them to undermine your foe.

spells.name: Elemental Blast
spells.notes: You gather elemental energy and blast your foes in one of the various listed shapes of your choosing, dealing 8d6 damage.

spells.name: Elemental Breath
spells.notes: Breathe out elemental energy.

spells.name: Elemental Confluence
spells.notes: Summon a confluence of four elementals.

spells.name: Elemental Counter
spells.notes: Use a countering element to protect against a spell.

spells.name: Elemental Form
spells.notes: Turn into an elemental.

spells.name: Elemental Gift
spells.notes: Infuse an ally with one of the four elements.

spells.name: Elemental Motion
spells.notes: You call upon your element to propel you, improving your Speed depending on your element.

spells.name: Elemental Sense
spells.notes: Gain a sense related to an element you choose.

spells.name: Elemental Sheath
spells.notes: You coat yourself in nature’s power.

spells.name: Elemental Tempest
spells.notes: Your spellcasting surrounds you in a storm of elemental energy.

spells.name: Elemental Toss
spells.notes: With a flick of your wrist, you fling a chunk of your elemental matter at your foe.

spells.name: Elemental Zone
spells.notes: Make one element more damaging in a zone.

spells.name: Elephant Form
spells.notes: You channel the primal forces of nature to transform into a Large battle form, specifically that of a powerful and terrifying elephant or similar creature, such as a mammoth, mastodon, or anancus.

spells.name: Elysian Whimsy
spells.notes: You overwhelm the target with an unexpected and unpredictable desire if it fails a Will save.

spells.name: Embed Message
spells.notes: Leave an illusory message to be triggered at a later date.

spells.name: Ember Doppelgänger
spells.notes: A fiery duplicate joins the battle.

spells.name: Embodiment of Battle
spells.notes: Your apparition guides your attacks and imparts its skill to your movements.

spells.name: Embrace Nothingness
spells.notes: You empty your body of substance, becoming one with nothingness.

spells.name: Embrace the Pit
spells.notes: Devil horns grow from your skull, and your skin takes on features of the devil responsible for your diabolic bloodline.

spells.name: Empathic Link
spells.notes: You forge a bond between yourself and the target, enabling you to feel each other's emotions.

spells.name: Empty Inside
spells.notes: You inject a sliver of the void into your mind, momentarily remaking it into a bleak and empty place.

spells.name: Empty Pack
spells.notes: You render every item inside the container you touch invisible, although the container itself remains visible.

spells.name: Endure
spells.notes: You invigorate the touched creature’s mind and urge it to press on.

spells.name: Enduring Might
spells.notes: Your own might mingles with divine power to protect you from harm.

spells.name: Energy Absorption
spells.notes: You're used to mitigating the damage done by bombs, siege engines, and magical artillery.

spells.name: Energy Aegis
spells.notes: A creature gains resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality and void damage.

spells.name: Enfeeble
spells.notes: Sap a creature's strength.

spells.name: Engrave Memory
spells.notes: Store memories in a stone.

spells.name: Enhance Senses
spells.notes: You enhance the target's senses.

spells.name: Enlarge
spells.notes: Cause a creature to grow in size.

spells.name: Enlarge Companion
spells.notes: Your animal companion grows much larger, towering over its foes in battle.

spells.name: Entangle Fate
spells.notes: You cause a swirl of energy to entangle the fates of all caught within the blast.

spells.name: Entangling Flora
spells.notes: Sprout plants to hinder movement in an area.

spells.name: Enthrall
spells.notes: Your speech makes creatures fascinated with you.

spells.name: Entrancing Eyes
spells.notes: Your eyes glow with an entrancing radiance that captivates those who meet your gaze.

spells.name: Entreat Spirit
spells.notes: You invite a spirit you’ve bonded with to bolster your mind.

spells.name: Entreat the Many
spells.notes: You manifest echoes of all the spirits you’ve ever bonded with at once, in a spiraling cyclone of colorful forms.

spells.name: Entropic Wheel
spells.notes: You stockpile thermal energy in a magical wheel-like construct that lets you burn opponents with cold or freeze their bodies with heat.

spells.name: Entwined Roots
spells.notes: Protect creatures with durable roots that can catch ranged weapons.

spells.name: Envenom Companion
spells.notes: Make your companion’s attacks toxic.

spells.name: Environmental Endurance
spells.notes: Protect a creature from severe cold or heat.

spells.name: Ephemeral Hazards
spells.notes: You create illusory hazards, such as spinning blades or a puddle of acid, in four 10-foot-by–10-foot spaces within range.

spells.name: Ephemeral Tracking
spells.notes: You can look at currents in the air and water and see tracks that you can follow just as you would on land.

spells.name: Equal Footing
spells.target: 1 creature with a land Speed greater than yours
spells.notes: You level the field between yourself and another creature, hampering its movements if it’s quicker than you.

spells.name: Eradicate Undeath
spells.notes: A massive deluge of life energy causes the undead to fall apart.

spells.name: Erase Trail
spells.notes: You drastically reduce all signs of one specific creature's passage from the area, including footprints, handprints, dirt, and minor changes caused to the surrounding environment, like the bending of grass.

spells.name: Establish Ward
spells.notes: You bind a part of your essence to your surroundings, creating a warded area that grants you power within it, but drains you outside of it.

spells.name: Ethereal Jaunt
spells.notes: Use the Ethereal Plane to move through objects and into the air.

spells.name: Etheric Shards
spells.notes: You reach out and sow glittering splinters of force throughout the area, otherworldly caltrops of will and ectoplasm.

spells.name: Euphoric Renewal
spells.notes: You view death not as an ending but a beginning, and you delight in dancing on its edge.

spells.name: Everlight
spells.target: a gemstone worth 6 gp or more
spells.notes: Cause a gem to glow eternally.

spells.name: Evil Eye
spells.notes: Your patron's resentment manifests in a baleful, envious gaze.

spells.name: Evolution Surge
spells.notes: You flood your eidolon with power, creating a temporary evolution in your eidolon’s capabilities.

spells.name: Exchange Image
spells.notes: Trade appearances with the target.

spells.name: Excise Lexicon
spells.notes: You reach into a creature's mind and extract its knowledge of a word.

spells.name: Execute
spells.notes: Pull a living creature toward death or an undead creature toward destruction.

spells.name: Expeditious Excavation
spells.notes: You remove loose dirt, dust, gravel, sand, and the like (though not solid stone) up to the size of a 5-foot cube.

spells.name: Exploding Earth
spells.notes: Throw an exploding ball of earth.

spells.name: Explosive Barrage
spells.notes: You fire a booming, fiery explosion followed by a salvo of smaller blasts, each cracking the air with the sound of thunder.

spells.name: Explosive Dust
spells.notes: Scatter explosive dust in the air.

spells.name: Expunge Blood
spells.notes: Remove the blood from an enemy.

spells.name: Extend Blood Magic
spells.notes: You call upon the arcane energy coursing through your blood to extend the magic it grants.

spells.name: Extend Boost
spells.notes: You focus on the intricacies of the magic binding you to your eidolon to extend the duration of your boost eidolon or reinforce eidolon spell.

spells.name: Extend Spell
spells.notes: You call upon your blood’s knowledge of the ancients to extend your magic.

spells.name: Extract Poison
spells.target: 1 poison on or in an object
spells.notes: Draw out poison from an object and make your next attack poisonous.

spells.name: Extradimensional Cover
spells.notes: You’ve learned how to bring extradimensional spaces filled with debris into your current reality.

spells.name: Eyes of the Dead
spells.target: one undead creature under your control
spells.notes: You enter a magical trance that allows you to perceive through the senses of the target creature.

spells.name: Fabricated Truth
spells.notes: Make creatures believe something is factual.

spells.name: Face in the Crowd
spells.notes: While in a crowd of roughly similar creatures, your appearance becomes bland and nondescript.

spells.name: Fact Check
spells.notes: You use your arcane knowledge to double-check the information learned.

spells.name: Faerie Dust
spells.notes: You sprinkle magical dust in the spell's area, making those within easier to trick.

spells.name: Fallen Soldier's Lament
spells.target: 1 corpse of a Medium or smaller creature that has died within the past 8 hours
spells.notes: You raise an illusion in the space of a fallen foe, crafting it to resemble a ghost of your target before parading it across the battlefield.

spells.name: Falling Sky
spells.notes: Extraordinary telekinetic pressure smashes down through the area, battering creatures within it to the ground.

spells.name: Falling Stars
spells.notes: Call down four pieces of the heavens to deal bludgeoning and elemental damage.

spells.name: Fallow Field
spells.notes: A sickly yellow light fills the area as entropic forces prevent healing .

spells.name: False Nature
spells.target: one unattended item or one item you’re holding
spells.notes: You create an illusion that makes an object seem to be something entirely different.

spells.name: False Vision
spells.notes: Trick a scrying spell.

spells.name: False Vitality
spells.notes: Gain temporary Hit Points.

spells.name: Falsify Heat
spells.notes: Make a creature’s body heat seem different.

spells.name: Familiar Form
spells.notes: You transform into a Tiny animal that commonly serves as a spellcaster's familiar.

spells.name: Familiar's Call
spells.notes: Teleport your familiar back to your side.

spells.name: Familiar's Resurrection
spells.target: your dead familiar of 4th level or lower
spells.notes: Return a familiar back to life.

spells.name: Familiar’s Face
spells.target: 1 willing creature that’s your animal companion or familiar
spells.notes: Implant your senses and voice in your companion.

spells.name: Far Reach
spells.notes: Use portals to extend your reach.

spells.name: Far Sight
spells.notes: You can see distant objects as if they were closer.

spells.name: Far-Flung Fetch
spells.target: 1 unattended object of light Bulk or less
spells.notes: You can pilfer an object even if it's outside the reach of your fingers.

spells.name: Fashionista
spells.notes: The target's clothes are transformed into ostentatious attire that epitomizes high-end local fashion.

spells.name: Fatal Aria
spells.notes: You perform music so perfect that the target may die of joy or sorrow.

spells.name: Fate's Travels
spells.notes: You get a vision of the creature when it was alive, and its last 10 minutes of travel.
spells.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

spells.name: Fated Confrontation
spells.target: you or 1 willing ally and 1 enemy
spells.notes: Isolate two fated opponents and let them twist each other’s fate.

spells.name: Fated Healing
spells.target: creatures who are hostile toward each other
spells.notes: You speak about the consequences of actions people take against each other and how it’s possible to break cycles of violence simply by making a different choice.

spells.name: Fateful Condemnation
spells.notes: You draw upon the target’s negative fate, causing this lingering destiny to afflict it and its nearby allies with the unintended consequences of its past lives.

spells.name: Favorable Review
spells.notes: You enchant a creature to ensure they have only good things to say about your show.
spells.source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

spells.name: Fear
spells.notes: Frighten a creature, possibly making it flee.

spells.name: Fear the Sun
spells.notes: You cause the creature’s vision to become particularly sensitive.

spells.name: Fearful Feast
spells.notes: You open your mouth wide and inhale sharply; you draw in the bravery, self-confidence, and hope to which the frightened target clings and then strip away the target’s false assumption that these fragile emotions can save them from the oblivion of terror.
spells.source: Divine Mysteries, Pathfinder #165: Eyes of Empty Death

spells.name: Feast of Ashes
spells.notes: You curse the target with a hunger no food can sate.

spells.name: Feet to Fins
spells.notes: Turn a creature's feet into fins, enabling it to swim but slowing it on land.

spells.name: Feral Shades
spells.notes: A cone of hound-shaped shades tear creatures apart.

spells.name: Ferrous Form
spells.notes: Turn your body into iron.

spells.name: Fetch
spells.notes: Teleport your familiar away to do a task before returning.

spells.name: Fey Disappearance
spells.notes: You become invisible and ignore natural difficult terrain (such as underbrush).

spells.name: Fey Form
spells.notes: Turn into a fey battle form.

spells.name: Fey Glamour
spells.notes: You call upon fey glamours to cloak an area or the targets in illusion.

spells.name: Field of Life
spells.notes: Create a vital energy field that heals those who remain within.

spells.name: Field of Razors
spells.notes: Fill an area with a tangle of razor wire.

spells.name: Fiendish Rift
spells.notes: Open a rift to an unholy realm.

spells.name: Fiery Body
spells.notes: Turn your body into living flame.

spells.name: Figment
spells.notes: Create a simple auditory or visual illusion.

spells.name: Filter Air
spells.notes: You suck in a rough breath of air, and your body automatically filters out the harmful molecules that would infest your lungs.

spells.name: Final Fate of The Locust Host
spells.notes: You conjure the rotting corpse of Deskari, previously Lord of the Locust Hosts, to the battlefield.

spells.name: Final Sacrifice
spells.target: 1 creature with the minion trait that you summoned or permanently control
spells.notes: Channel energy to blow up your minion.

spells.name: Fire Ray
spells.notes: A blazing band of fire arcs through the air, lighting your opponent and the ground they stand upon on fire.

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.notes: You create a hovering shield made of fire.

spells.name: Fire's Pathway
spells.notes: Teleport from fire to fire.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.notes: An explosion of fire in an area burns creatures.

spells.name: Fireproof
spells.notes: Protect an object against catching fire.

spells.name: Firework Blast
spells.notes: You create a massive display of loud and colorful explosions.

spells.name: Fishing Spot
spells.notes: Catch a fish that can bolster whoever eats it.

spells.name: Flame Barrier
spells.target: one creature that would take fire damage from the triggering effect
spells.notes: You swiftly deflect incoming flames.

spells.name: Flame Dancer
spells.notes: Encircle a creature in flames to inflame its strikes and give it an intimidating dance.

spells.name: Flame Vortex
spells.notes: Invoke a moving tornado of fire and wind.

spells.name: Flame Wisp
spells.notes: Fire wisps damage those you strike, and more grow if you cast fire spells.

spells.name: Flames of Ego
spells.notes: Light up a creature and make it fascinated with itself.

spells.name: Flaming Fusillade
spells.notes: You call upon an endless barrage of flames, a series of explosions bursting around you like miniature suns.

spells.name: Flammable Fumes
spells.notes: Conjure poisonous fumes that can explode in flame.

spells.name: Flashy Disappearance
spells.notes: You create a puff of colorful smoke that quickly disperses while you become temporarily invisible .

spells.name: Fleet Step
spells.notes: Make your Speed much faster.

spells.name: Flense
spells.notes: With a touch, you strip off the flesh, muscle, and internal organs off your target, leaving only bare bones.

spells.name: Flesh Tsunami
spells.notes: You melt one of your thralls into a massive wave of sticky flesh.

spells.name: Flicker
spells.notes: Protect yourself from most damage as you teleport erratically.

spells.name: Floating Flame
spells.notes: Summoned fire moves at your command.

spells.name: Floating Harness
spells.notes: Connect a harness to your companion, eidolon, or familiar.

spells.name: Flourishing Flora
spells.notes: Grow a patch of cacti, flowers, fruits, or roots to hurt your enemies.

spells.name: Flowing Strike
spells.notes: Flow on a wave and attack on the way.

spells.name: Flurry of Claws
spells.target: 2 creatures no more than 10 feet from each other
spells.notes: Vicious dragon claws appear and slash at two nearby foes.

spells.name: Fly
spells.notes: Grant the target a fly Speed.

spells.name: Focusing Hum
spells.notes: You infuse the air around you with a sustained hum that allows creatures within it to resist distractions.

spells.name: Fold Metal
spells.target: 1 unattended metallic object up to 5 Bulk
spells.notes: Bend a metal object into a ball.

spells.name: Font of Serenity
spells.notes: A divine beacon radiates serenity, soothing nearby allies.

spells.name: For Love, For Lightning
spells.notes: When you Cast the Spell, you plunge the required weapon into the ground, where it crackles with crimson lightning.

spells.name: Foraging Friends
spells.notes: Giving a cheerful whistle, you call forth a handful of small animals, such as birds or mice, to collect food for you and your allies.

spells.name: Forbidden Thought
spells.notes: You place a psychic lock in a foe's mind that prevents it from a specific action.

spells.name: Forbidding Ward
spells.notes: Protect an ally against one specific enemy.

spells.name: Force Barrage
spells.notes: Pelt creatures with unerring shards of magical force.

spells.name: Force Bolt
spells.notes: You fire an arrow-shaped bolt of force, one of the most common and reliable forms of battle magic.

spells.name: Force Fang
spells.notes: You briefly transform your attack into pure force energy to bypass your opponent’s defenses.

spells.name: Force Fling
spells.notes: A magical force echo of your weapon flies out to attack a foe.

spells.name: Force Rain
spells.notes: Rain down shards of solid magic.

spells.name: Forced Mercy
spells.notes: You soften the target’s blows, ensuring they avoid vital areas and cause no lasting harm.

spells.name: Forceful Hand
spells.notes: Create a hand of force that can interpose to defend you or attack if heightened.

spells.name: Foresee the Path
spells.notes: You see just a split second into the future and glean how an enemy will move.

spells.name: Foresight
spells.notes: Danger sense warns you when a creature is in danger and protects it with good fortune.

spells.name: Forest of Gates
spells.target: you and up to 6 willing creatures touched
spells.notes: You transport yourself and your allies to a peaceful extraplanar realm of towering trees, each of which holds a misty gateway to another location.

spells.name: Forge
spells.notes: Developed before the introduction of the Iron Lagoon, this cantrip for superheating metal has also found valuable combat use.

spells.name: Forgotten Lines
spells.notes: Restore destroyed or censored text.

spells.name: Fortify Summoning
spells.notes: As you call a creature to your side, your magic transforms its body, heightening its ferocity and fortifying its resilience.

spells.name: Fortissimo Composition
spells.notes: You call upon your muse to greatly increase the benefits you provide with your courageous anthem, rallying anthem, or song of strength composition.

spells.name: Foul Miasma
spells.notes: You multiply the disease within a creature, drawing it into an infectious mist outside their body where it can spread to other creatures.

spells.name: Fractious Echo
spells.notes: Make a Strike that separates the target’s spirit from their body.

spells.name: Freeze Time
spells.notes: Briefly stop time for everything but you.

spells.name: Freezing Rain
spells.notes: Chill and slow creatures with cold rain.

spells.name: Freezing Touch
spells.notes: Freeze a creature with a single touch.

spells.name: Frenzied Revelry
spells.target: you and allies in the area
spells.notes: You recall memories of hedonistic rites to send yourself into an infectious frenzy, dancing and howling wildly to encourage your companions to join in.

spells.name: Friendfetch
spells.notes: You shoot out ephemeral, telekinetic strands that drag each target directly toward you, stopping in the closest unoccupied space to you in this path.

spells.name: Friendly Push
spells.notes: You exert magical force to propel a willing creature up to 10 feet in a straight line , including upward, though if they aren’t on solid ground or have another way to maintain their height (such as a fly Speed ) when the movement ends, they fall.

spells.name: Friends to Foes
spells.notes: Sow distrust into the mind of an enemy.

spells.name: Frigid Flurry
spells.notes: Turn into slashing snow and fly in a straight line.

spells.name: Frog Tongue
spells.notes: Your tongue extends unnaturally, flicking out toward a creature within range and dealing bludgeoning damage.

spells.name: Frost Pillar
spells.notes: Freeze a creature in a pillar of ice.

spells.name: Frost's Touch
spells.notes: Your gelid shard drinks down nearby heat in a futile attempt to sate itself and achieve a level of frigid cold unheard of on the Material Plane .

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.notes: Damage a creature with bitter cold.

spells.name: Frozen Fog
spells.notes: You conjure a chilling mist that settles into the bones and makes it difficult to move.

spells.name: Frozen Lungs
spells.notes: Freeze a creature’s lungs.

spells.name: Fulminating Impact
spells.notes: Charge your attacks with electric energy.

spells.name: Funeral Flames
spells.target: one club or staff you're wielding
spells.notes: You transform a bludgeon into a fearsome torch suited to casting undead into the afterlife.

spells.name: Fungal Exhalation
spells.notes: You exhale toxic mold spores that fill the area.

spells.name: Fungal Hyphae
spells.notes: Thin hyphae grow from your feet and plunge into the earth, creating a symbiotic fungal network that attaches to plants within 30 feet and connects you to their root systems.

spells.name: Fungal Infestation
spells.notes: Plant poisonous fungal growths in a creature.

spells.name: Gale Blast
spells.notes: Damage and push adjacent creatures with air.

spells.name: Garden of Healing
spells.notes: Spirits of comfort and respite swirl around you, trailing visions of growing grass and blooming blossoms.

spells.name: Garden of Stone
spells.notes: Raise a stalagmite surrounded by spiky stones.

spells.name: Garden Of The Green Man's Growth
spells.notes: You cast your magic into the earth, calling out to a powerful green man , a verdant lesser deity of nature, to come to your aid.

spells.name: Gasping Marsh
spells.notes: With a rattling hiss, you create a quickly evaporating mist of invisible poisonous marsh gas to smother creatures in the area.

spells.name: Gate
spells.notes: Tear open a portal to another plane.

spells.name: Gecko Grip
spells.notes: Give a creature a climb Speed.

spells.name: Genie's Veil
spells.notes: With a flourish, you fulfill a creature's wish for protection, bending reality to keep them from harm.

spells.name: Gentle Breeze
spells.notes: Create a soothing wind that heals and reduces heat.

spells.name: Gentle Landing
spells.notes: React to save a falling creature.

spells.name: Geyser
spells.notes: Blast foes upward with superheated water, causing them to fall and leaving concealing fog.

spells.name: Ghost Rush
spells.notes: Quickly move, ignoring obstacles in your path.

spells.name: Ghostly Carrier
spells.notes: Create a semicorporeal figure that carries your touch spells to targets.

spells.name: Ghostly Shift
spells.notes: Your body becomes insubstantial as you partially phase out.

spells.name: Ghostly Tragedy
spells.notes: Have spirits re-enact a violent event.

spells.name: Ghostly Transcription
spells.notes: Glowing letters assemble in the air, providing a transcription of the target’s speech in all languages you speak.

spells.name: Ghostly Weapon
spells.target: 1 weapon that is either unattended or wielded by you or a willing ally
spells.notes: Make a weapon affect incorporeal creatures.

spells.name: Ghoulish Cravings
spells.notes: Afflict a creature with a craving for raw meat.

spells.name: Gift of the Anemos
spells.notes: Your apparition envelops you in gusting winds that can speed your steps or buffet your foes.

spells.name: Girzanje's March
spells.notes: You sing a prayer for war, inspiring valor in allies who hear your song.

spells.name: Glacial Causeway
spells.notes: Create a line of ice that you can glide upon.

spells.name: Glacial Heart
spells.notes: Ice and bone-deep cold assail the target, freezing it from the inside out.

spells.name: Glacial Skewer
spells.notes: Launch an impaling ice spike at an enemy.

spells.name: Glamorize
spells.notes: Using simple magical gestures, you alter a minor detail of your appearance.

spells.name: Glass Form
spells.notes: Turn a creature’s body into living glass.

spells.name: Glass Sand
spells.notes: You throw a handful of sand that transforms into jagged shards of glass.

spells.name: Glass Shield
spells.notes: Protect yourself with a glass shield.

spells.name: Gleaming Pet
spells.notes: Cause your companion or eidolon to glow with a blinding light.

spells.name: Glimmer of Charm
spells.notes: Briefly improve the attitude of nearby creatures with a charming aura.

spells.name: Glimpse the Truth
spells.notes: Divine insight lets you see things as they are, unveiled by attempts to magically cloak the truth.

spells.name: Glimpse Weakness
spells.notes: You glimpse a loose scale, a seam in a foe's armor, or a similar weakness, aiding your allies in landing a precise hit.

spells.name: Glossolalia
spells.notes: Scramble a creature’s ability to speak.

spells.name: Glowing Trail
spells.notes: Your movements leave a vague glowing path behind you, like a misty echo of your presence.
spells.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

spells.name: Glutton's Jaws
spells.notes: A slavering maw opens beneath a target and tries to take a bite out of them.

spells.name: Gluttonous Growth
spells.notes: Plants in the area grow rapidly, taking on carnivorous characteristics as they seek to consume prey.

spells.name: Goblin Pox
spells.notes: Infect a creature with goblin pox.

spells.name: Gouging Claw
spells.notes: Morph your limb into a claw and attack with it.

spells.name: Grasp of the Deep
spells.notes: Make a creature feel like it’s being crushed underwater.

spells.name: Grasping Earth
spells.notes: Create hands of rock from the ground to grab creatures.

spells.name: Grasping Grave
spells.notes: Hundreds of skeletal arms erupt from the ground in the area, clawing at creatures within and attempting to hold them in place.

spells.name: Grasping Vine
spells.target: 1 unattended object of up to 8 Bulk, or Medium or smaller creature that is currently on the ground
spells.notes: A thick, curling vine erupts from the ground beneath you and stretches to the target, allowing you to move it around.

spells.name: Grave Impressions
spells.notes: You project a fragment of your senses into the corpse.

spells.name: Gravitational Pull
spells.notes: Pull one or more creatures toward you.

spells.name: Gravity Wave
spells.notes: Knock down foes with a wave of rippling gravity.

spells.name: Gravity Weapon
spells.notes: You build up gravitational force and funnel it into your blows, leading to more powerful attacks with blade and bow alike.

spells.name: Gravity Well
spells.notes: Pull all creatures towards the center of a sphere of altered gravity.

spells.name: Gray Shadow
spells.notes: You pray over a dying creature, drawing its shadow into your service as long as its owner is stooped at death's door.

spells.name: Grease
spells.notes: Cover a target or an area with slippery grease.

spells.name: Grim Tendrils
spells.notes: Creatures in a line take void damage and start to bleed.

spells.name: Grisly Growths
spells.notes: A creature grows sickening limbs and organs.

spells.name: Gritty Wheeze
spells.notes: You exhale desiccating grit and sand in a small cloud.

spells.name: Groom Companion
spells.notes: Clean your companion or eidolon.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.notes: Divine guidance improves one roll.

spells.name: Guided Introspection
spells.notes: You guide the target in examining their innermost feelings, their behaviors, and the motivations behind their actions, granting them clarity and insight.

spells.name: Guiding Star
spells.notes: Constellations nudge the target to travel to a location you choose.

spells.name: Gust of Wind
spells.notes: Wind blows out fires and knocks back objects and creatures.

spells.name: Hag's Fruit
spells.notes: You imbue a single piece of fruit with a curse that leaves its victims in a magical sleep.

spells.name: Halcyon Infusion
spells.target: one willing creature of lower level than you
spells.notes: You infuse magical energy into your target, opening up their mind to the pathways of magic and granting them the ability to use magic to affect the world around them.

spells.name: Halcyon Mists
spells.notes: In a moment of dire need, you call upon ancestral power to strengthen and sustain.

spells.name: Hallowed Ground
spells.notes: One small space becomes inhospitable to undead as you fill it with life-infused benevolent magic.

spells.name: Hallucination
spells.notes: Cause a creature to believe one thing is another, to notice something that isn't there, or to be unable to detect something.

spells.name: Hand of the Apprentice
spells.notes: You take advantage of one of the most fundamental lessons of magic to levitate and propel your weapon.

spells.name: Harm
spells.target: 1 living creature or 1 willing undead creature
spells.notes: Void energy harms the living or heals the undead, either a single creature or all in a burst.

spells.name: Harmonize Self
spells.notes: You heal yourself in one of the following ways, chosen by you when you cast the spell.

spells.name: Haste
spells.notes: Speed up a creature so it can attack or move more often.

spells.name: Hasted Assault
spells.notes: You call upon your magic to speed up your attacks.

spells.name: Haunting Hymn
spells.notes: A powerful hymn harms and deafens.

spells.name: Haunting Spirit
spells.notes: Haunt an foe with a spirit only they can see.

spells.name: Heal
spells.target: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature
spells.notes: Vital energy heals the living or harms the undead, either a single creature or all in a burst.

spells.name: Heal Animal
spells.notes: You heal an animal's wounds, restoring 1d8 Hit Points to the target.

spells.name: Heal Companion
spells.notes: You heal your animal companion's wounds.

spells.name: Healer's Blessing
spells.notes: Your words bless a creature with an enhanced connection to vital energy.

spells.name: Healing Plaster
spells.target: a handful of dirt or mud
spells.notes: Transform mud into a healing plaster to treat wounds without healer's tools.

spells.name: Healing Well
spells.notes: Create a well that you and your allies can use to heal.

spells.name: Heart's Desire
spells.notes: You surround your target with wondrous illusions of their greatest desires, which distract them from reality.

spells.name: Heart's Hook
spells.notes: You drive two creatures toward a fated meeting

spells.name: Heartbolt
spells.target: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature
spells.notes: Launch an exploding bolt of vital energy.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.notes: Make metal red hot.

spells.name: Heatvision
spells.notes: Let a creature see heat.

spells.name: Heaving Earth
spells.target: 1 creature or object on the ground
spells.notes: Make a shockwave that pushes creatures in the way and explodes when it reaches a target.

spells.name: Hedge Prison
spells.notes: You conjure an intricate hedge prison to trap a creature, encasing them completely in a hollow cube of dense bushes.

spells.name: Heinous Future
spells.notes: You hold up fractured mirror to the target, and in that mirror it sees a thing that may yet come to pass.

spells.name: Hellfire Plume
spells.notes: You call forth a plume of hellfire that erupts from below

spells.name: Helpful Reload
spells.notes: With a quick gesture, you reload your ally’s weapon, allowing them to focus on fighting the enemy.

spells.name: Helpful Scribe
spells.notes: Conjure a quill that can copy written language.

spells.name: Helpful Steps
spells.notes: You call forth a ladder or staircase to help you reach greater heights.

spells.name: Helpful Wood Spirits
spells.notes: Make a gaggle of wood spirits carry out a small task.

spells.name: Hero's Defiance
spells.notes: You shout in defiance and are filled with a burst of healing.

spells.name: Heroic Feat
spells.notes: You gain the ability to perform a specialized combat technique from the vast wealth of martial knowledge your mystery provides.

spells.name: Heroism
spells.notes: Stoke a creature's inner heroism to make it more competent.

spells.name: Hidden Mind
spells.notes: Protect a creature from mental magic and effects that pry into its secrets.

spells.name: Hidebound
spells.notes: The target’s skin erupts in thick hide or dense scales.

spells.name: Hippocampus Retreat
spells.notes: You temporarily shape your lower limbs into the tail of a hippocampus in order to swim away from a nearby foe after dealing a parting blow.

spells.name: Hollow Heart
spells.notes: You stoke the target's ambition beyond reason, until it believes no one is capable of helping it.

spells.name: Hologram Cage
spells.notes: You weave light into a cube of vivid and fantastic patterns.

spells.name: Holy Cascade
spells.notes: Make an explosion of holy water.

spells.name: Holy Host
spells.notes: In stories, armies with just and righteous causes win with little difficulty, conquering unholy legions.

spells.name: Holy Light
spells.notes: A ray of burning light deals extra damage to fiends and other unholy creatures.

spells.name: Home Among Mulberry Leaves
spells.notes: Qi-formed threads unravel from your fabric on conjured needles as your attack makes contact with an enemy and wraps it in place like an insect in its cocoon.

spells.name: Honeyed Words
spells.notes: Make even the most unlikely lies more believable.

spells.name: Hop, Skip, Jump
spells.notes: Teleport to 3 spaces over the course of 3 rounds.

spells.name: Horde of Underlings
spells.notes: You summon six underlings, such as skeletons or kobolds .

spells.name: Horizon Thunder Sphere
spells.notes: Gather energy and throw lightning.

spells.name: Horizon's Veil
spells.notes: Create an area of warped perception.

spells.name: Horrific Visage
spells.notes: You briefly transform your features into the horrific visage of a hag, striking fear into your enemies.

spells.name: Horrifying Blood Loss
spells.notes: You curse the target, filling it with terror at the loss of its blood.

spells.name: Hot Air
spells.notes: Your enemies are full of hot air, so you make their lungs burn when they try to talk.

spells.name: House of Imaginary Walls
spells.notes: You mime an invisible 10-foot-by-10-foot wall adjacent to you and within your reach.

spells.name: Howling Blizzard
spells.notes: Fill a cone or burst with cold winds and snowdrifts.

spells.name: Humanoid Form
spells.notes: Take the shape of a humanoid.

spells.name: Hungry Depths
spells.notes: Open a door to corrupted water that damages and consumes.

spells.name: Hunter's Luck
spells.notes: You have a preternatural ability to remember details about your foes.

spells.name: Hunter's Vision
spells.notes: Your target glows with a magical aura visible only to you and those who follow your lead.

spells.name: Hurtling Stone
spells.notes: You evoke a magical stone and throw it, with divine guide to your aim.

spells.name: Hydraulic Push
spells.notes: Damage and push a creature with a blast of water.

spells.name: Hydraulic Torrent
spells.notes: Force creatures back with a damaging line of water.

spells.name: Hymn of Healing
spells.notes: Your glorious singing mends wounds and provides a temporary respite from harm.

spells.name: Hypercognition
spells.notes: Recall massive amounts of information in an instant.

spells.name: Hypnopompic Terrors
spells.notes: You send a wave of nightmarish visions crashing over your targets, leaving them paralyzed by fear.

spells.name: Hypnotize
spells.notes: Shifting colors dazzle and fascinate creatures.

spells.name: Ibex's Harvest
spells.notes: In the tale “Ibex’s Harvest,” Ibex turns from the path of a warrior to the path of a farmer, building up their community by working hard and sharing a bountiful harvest not just with their humanoid neighbors but also with their animal neighbors.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.notes: Call a storm cloud that pelts creatures with hail.

spells.name: Ignite Ambition
spells.notes: You strengthen the target's ambition, increase its resentment of its allies, and make its allegiances more susceptible to change.

spells.name: Ignite Fireworks
spells.notes: Throw exploding fireworks.

spells.name: Ignition
spells.notes: Burn a creature up close or at range.

spells.name: Ill Omen
spells.notes: Curse a creature with misfortune.

spells.name: Illuminate
spells.notes: Kindle all light sources around you.

spells.name: Illusory Creature
spells.notes: Form a convincing illusion of a creature.

spells.name: Illusory Disguise
spells.notes: Make yourself look like a different creature.

spells.name: Illusory Object
spells.notes: Form a convincing illusion of an object.

spells.name: Illusory Scene
spells.notes: Create an imaginary scene containing multiple creatures and objects.

spells.name: Illusory Shroud
spells.notes: You shroud the target in subtle illusions that make it difficult to detect.

spells.name: Imaginary Lockbox
spells.target: 1 container and its contents, totaling 10 Bulk or less
spells.notes: Hide items in a mental compartment.

spells.name: Imaginary Weapon
spells.notes: You create a simple weapon of force and lash out, its arc following your hand.

spells.name: Imitate Fauna
spells.notes: You use your knowledge of nature to pass the target off as a common animal of the same size, representing a species chosen when the spell is cast.

spells.name: Imp Sting
spells.notes: You reproduce an imp's evil, poisonous sting, stabbing at an enemy and possibly affecting them with the devil's benumbing venom.
spells.source: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

spells.name: Impaling Briars
spells.notes: The ground within the area transforms into a mass of dangerous briars that assault and impede your foes.

spells.name: Impaling Spike
spells.notes: Skewer a creature with a cold iron spike.

spells.name: Impart Empathy
spells.notes: You expand the target's ability to understand social cues that are normally beyond its comprehension.

spells.name: Impeccable Flow
spells.notes: You attune yourself to an underlying cosmic order to the world.

spells.name: Impending Doom
spells.notes: Make a foe witness its potential death and become distressed.

spells.name: Implement of Destruction
spells.target: 1 enemy, and 1 weapon that is either unattended or wielded by you or a willing ally
spells.notes: You solemnly declare that the target weapon will bring death to a foe.

spells.name: Implosion
spells.notes: Make a creature collapse in on itself.

spells.name: Imprint Message
spells.notes: Put a false psychic imprint in an object.
spells.source: Player Core 2, Pathfinder #147: Tomorrow Must Burn

spells.name: Imprinting Hand
spells.notes: Imprint your hand into a creature to thwart future healing.

spells.name: Incarnate Ancient Specter
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate wraith that causes enemies to bow down and weep bloody tears.

spells.name: Incarnate Archmage
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate archmage to fire magic missiles, stupefy foes, and tear away their spells.

spells.name: Incarnate Deific Herald
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate representative of your deity, with effects depending on sanctification.

spells.name: Incarnate Draconic Legion
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate legion of dragons to destroy your foes.

spells.name: Incarnate Faerie Revelers
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate faerie revel that creates mischief and mischance.

spells.name: Incarnate Kaiju
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate kaiju with effects depending on the specific kaiju.

spells.name: Incarnate Shadow Minuet
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate of your own shadow that steals shadows and creates darkness.

spells.name: Incarnate Skeletal Giant
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate giant skeleton that shakes the earth and attacks your foes.

spells.name: Incarnate Tempest of Shades
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate storm of spirits that drains and frightens your foes.

spells.name: Incarnate Wild Rose
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate giant rose that entangles foes and poisons the air.

spells.name: Incendiary Ashes
spells.notes: A cloud of magical ashes descends upon creatures in the area.

spells.name: Incendiary Aura
spells.notes: You surround yourself with a combustible aura.

spells.name: Incendiary Fog
spells.notes: You summon a cloud of flammable black dust.

spells.name: Indestructibility
spells.notes: Become briefly immune to everything.

spells.name: Indolent Haze
spells.notes: The faint scent of poppies and a soothing calm fill the area, urging creatures to lay down and take a rest.

spells.name: Inertia Lock
spells.target: 1 held object of 2 Bulk or less
spells.notes: Lock an object in its space with gravity.

spells.name: Inevitable Destination
spells.notes: You twist the paths of the target, ensuring that each one leads to you.

spells.name: Inevitable Disaster
spells.notes: Twist fate to damage a foe in the near future.

spells.name: Inexhaustible Cynicism
spells.notes: Make creatures paranoid and cynical.

spells.name: Infectious Comedy
spells.notes: You tell a magical joke and infect a target with laughter that spreads to those nearby.

spells.name: Infectious Ennui
spells.notes: With a wave of your hand and a short invocation, you cause feelings of ennui and impending doom to well up in the mind of the targeted creature, who must attempt a Will save.

spells.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
spells.notes: You and an ally are both encouraged to improve one roll.

spells.name: Infectious Melody
spells.notes: An infectious tune makes creatures sing along.

spells.name: Infiltrator's Tunnel
spells.notes: It's best to know the ingress and egress points for any location you plan to rob.

spells.name: Infinitesimal Collapse Field
spells.notes: Field Warp space and time around yourself to slow down enemies.

spells.name: Information Overload
spells.notes: You call on Cobyslarni to open the target’s mind to knowledge—too much knowledge

spells.name: Infuse Vitality
spells.notes: Empower attacks with vital energy to damage the undead.

spells.name: Inkshot
spells.notes: A spray of viscous, toxic ink jets from your fingertip to strike a target creature in the face.

spells.name: Inner Radiance Torrent
spells.notes: Gather spiritual energy to fire a storm of force bolts and beams.

spells.name: Inner Upheaval
spells.notes: You focus your qi into devastating magical attacks.

spells.name: Inscrutable Mask
spells.notes: You shroud your form and features in an impenetrable mask of shadow.

spells.name: Insect Form
spells.notes: Turn into a dangerous giant insect.

spells.name: Inside Ropes
spells.notes: You pull a large handful of guts from your midsection.

spells.name: Instant Armor
spells.notes: Set a contingency to return your armor to you.

spells.name: Instant Minefield
spells.notes: You create several hidden mines throughout the area that explode when stepped on.

spells.name: Instant Parade
spells.notes: An illusory parade with dozens of participants and performers appears around you, following you as you move.

spells.name: Instant Pottery
spells.notes: Create earthenware objects.

spells.name: Interdisciplinary Incantation
spells.notes: You gather the embers of another caster's spell, using your understanding of unified magic to pick apart their formulas and incantations well enough to imitate the spell yourself, if only for a short time.

spells.name: Internal Insurrection
spells.notes: You afflict the target with the supernatural disease known as internal insurrection, causing portions of their body to rebel against the whole, leading to painful agonies and, in time, death.

spells.name: Interplanar Teleport
spells.notes: Transport creatures to another plane in the Multiverse.

spells.name: Interposing Earth
spells.notes: React to make a barrier of earth.

spells.name: Interstellar Void
spells.notes: You call upon the frigid depths of outer space to bring a terrible chill to your enemy.

spells.name: Invent Code
spells.target: yourself and up to 3 other willing creatures
spells.notes: Invent a new language for you and the targets.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.notes: A creature can't be seen until it attacks.

spells.name: Invisibility Cloak
spells.notes: You become invisible, with the same restrictions as the 2nd-rank invisibility spell.

spells.name: Invisibility Curtain
spells.notes: Wall makes creatures on one side invisible to the other side.

spells.name: Invisible Item
spells.notes: Make an item disappear.

spells.name: Invoke Spirits
spells.notes: Call a group of ghostly apparitions to attack your foes.

spells.name: Invoke the Crimson Oath
spells.notes: Unleash a blast of ruby light, striking all before you.

spells.name: Invoke the Harrow
spells.notes: You draw a card from the harrow, either one from a deck you have in hand or magically produce one as part of the spell.

spells.name: Invoke True Name
spells.target: 1 creature whose true name you know
spells.notes: You speak the true name of a creature to more surely affect it with your magic.

spells.name: Iron Gut
spells.notes: Your mouth, esophagus, and stomach become incredibly elastic and tougher than metal.

spells.name: Iron Rain
spells.notes: Rain down iron blades upon your enemies.

spells.name: Isolation
spells.notes: You summon a tangible manifestation of loneliness to cloak the target from view as surely as if it were wreathed in darkness.

spells.name: It Is Written
spells.notes: You envision a future for yourself, confident in the certainty that this vision is your destiny.

spells.name: Item Facade
spells.target: 1 object no more than 10 feet by 10 feet by 10 feet
spells.notes: Disguise an item to look perfect or shoddy.

spells.name: Jassim's Allegiance
spells.notes: You bartered for this spell in some strange market or perhaps gained it while wandering the desert, hopelessly lost and surrounded by nothing but the remnants of time and fallen empires.

spells.name: Jealous Hex
spells.notes: You draw forth a hag's innate jealousy to deny a target its greatest attribute.

spells.name: Join Pasts
spells.notes: Share thoughts and experiences with allies.

spells.name: Jump
spells.notes: Make an impressive leap.

spells.name: Juvenile Companion
spells.notes: Turn your companion into its juvenile form.

spells.name: Keen Smell
spells.notes: Your nose becomes more sensitive to the scents of the wild, the better for you to track your quarry.

spells.name: Kgalaserke's Axes
spells.notes: The folklore and tales surrounding the legendary hero Kgalaserke are so widespread and well known that a hundred lifetimes would not be enough to have accomplished everything she is reputed to have done.

spells.name: Ki Cutting Sight
spells.notes: Ki flows through everything. Strike at just the right place with dire consequences

spells.name: Kinetic Ram
spells.notes: Gathering kinetic energy, you either focus it in a straight line or disperse it as an encircling ripple.

spells.name: King's Castle
spells.notes: You and a willing creature swap places.

spells.name: Knock
spells.notes: Make a door, lock, or container easier to open, and possibly open it immediately.

spells.name: Know Location
spells.notes: You create an invisible anchor at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect), as long as you can identify the location by its appearance (or other identifying features).
spells.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

spells.name: Know the Enemy
spells.notes: You quickly remind yourself of useful information.

spells.name: Know the Way
spells.notes: Learn true north and the direction to another location.

spells.name: Lament
spells.notes: You let out your negative emotions in a guttural wail that shakes your enemies’ hearts and deals 1d8 mental damage (basic Will save) to each creature in the area.

spells.name: Lashing Rope
spells.target: up to 50 feet of unattended rope or an inanimate rope-like object
spells.notes: You cause a section of rope or a rope-like object to animate, slither to your square, and encircle you, wreathing you in twisting, lashing fibers.

spells.name: Lashunta's Life Bubble
spells.notes: You create a replenishing protective bubble of fresh, temperate air around the target.

spells.name: Laughing Fit
spells.notes: Laughter impedes a creature's actions.

spells.name: Lay on Hands
spells.target: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature
spells.notes: Your hands become infused with powerful vitality, capable of healing a living creature or damaging an undead creature with a touch.

spells.name: Leaden Steps
spells.notes: Make creatures heavy and weak to electricity.

spells.name: Leng Sting
spells.notes: You use the power of nightmares to magically replicate the venomous attack of the aberrant and cunning Leng spiders.
spells.source: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

spells.name: Let not the Fallen Rest
spells.notes: You exhort your fallen comrades to return to the battle.

spells.name: Levitate
spells.notes: Float an object or creature a few feet off the ground.

spells.name: Liberating Command
spells.notes: You call out a liberating cry, urging an ally to break free of an effect that holds them in place.

spells.name: Life Boost
spells.notes: Life force from your patron floods into the target, ensuring they can continue doing your patron's will for just a little longer.

spells.name: Life Connection
spells.notes: Set a contingency to take damage for an ally.

spells.name: Life Link
spells.notes: You forge a connection of life energy between you and your target, distributing harm between both of you.

spells.name: Life Pact
spells.notes: Using your life force or spirit as a conduit, you bind the targets in a mystical pact.

spells.name: Life Siphon
spells.notes: You use some of the spell’s magic to heal yourself.

spells.name: Life Tap
spells.notes: Using a thrall as a siphon, you attempt to drain the life essence of a creature and use it to restore the life of yourself or an ally.

spells.name: Life's Flowing River
spells.notes: You create a flowing river of ghostly water and that sheds dim light for 10 feet on each side.

spells.name: Life's Fresh Bloom
spells.notes: The ground around you blooms with life, sprouting sparkling grass, flowers, and small shrubs.

spells.name: Life-Draining Roots
spells.notes: Roots hurt creatures in a line and transfer their vitality to you.

spells.name: Life-Giving Form
spells.notes: You transcend your physical form, becoming a beacon of healing energy.

spells.name: Lifelink Surge
spells.notes: You make a quick gesture, tracing the link between yourself and your eidolon and drawing on your connection to slowly strengthen your shared life force. Your eidolon gains fast healing 4 for 4 rounds.

spells.name: Lifewood Cage
spells.notes: Trap a creature in a wooden cage.

spells.name: Lift Nature's Caul
spells.notes: With a wave of the hand, you cause all creatures in the area to see the world around them as if a gauzy film had been lifted away to expose the truth that lies below their perceived reality.

spells.name: Light
spells.notes: Make an object glow.

spells.name: Light of Revelation
spells.notes: Shed light, granting a bonus to Perception.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.notes: Lightning strikes all creatures in a line.

spells.name: Lightning Lasso
spells.notes: Bind a creature in an electric lasso.

spells.name: Lightning Storm
spells.notes: Create clouds and call down lightning.

spells.name: Lignify
spells.notes: Turn a creature to wood.

spells.name: Liminal Doorway
spells.notes: A chalk door opens to an extradimensional hiding place.

spells.name: Lingering Composition
spells.notes: You add a flourish to your composition to extend its benefits.

spells.name: Linnorm Sting
spells.notes: You replicate the fiery venom of the tor linnorm and inflict an enemy with the dread dragon's debilitating bite.
spells.source: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

spells.name: Litany against Sloth
spells.notes: Your litany rails against the sin of sloth, interfering with the target’s ability to react.

spells.name: Litany Against Wrath
spells.notes: Your litany rails against the sin of wrath, punishing the target for attacking good creatures.

spells.name: Litany of Depravity
spells.notes: Your litany calls into question the morals your foe claims to hold dear.

spells.name: Litany of Righteousness
spells.notes: Your litany denounces an evildoer, rendering it susceptible to the powers of good.

spells.name: Litany of Self-Interest
spells.notes: You give a speech that fills your target with a drive to improve themself to the exclusion of assisting others.

spells.name: Live Wire
spells.notes: Slash and shock a creature with an electrified filament.

spells.name: Lively Flight
spells.notes: Create wings made of healing vital energy.

spells.name: Living Graveyard
spells.notes: You conjure forth a walking bulk of graves and tombstones held together by the buried dead.

spells.name: Living Terrain
spells.notes: Give life to the earth to destabilize your foes.

spells.name: Living Thunderbolt
spells.notes: Transform yourself into a lightning bolt.

spells.name: Localized Quake
spells.notes: You shake the earth, toppling nearby creatures.

spells.name: Locate
spells.target: 1 specific object or type of object
spells.notes: Learn the direction to an object.

spells.name: Lock
spells.target: 1 lock, or a door or container with a latch
spells.notes: Make a lock much harder to open.
