spells.notes: Make an illusion of yourself you can cast spells through.

spells.name: Proliferating Eyes
spells.notes: You implant a contagious, scrying eye that spreads to others by touch.

spells.name: Propelling Air Stream
spells.notes: Fire a blast of air that lifts you off the ground.

spells.name: Prophet's Luck
spells.notes: You prophesize the result of the triggering saving throw as either a success (including a critical success) or a failure (including a critical failure).

spells.name: Propulsive Breeze
spells.notes: React to extend a Stride or Leap.

spells.name: Protect Companion
spells.target: your eidolon, or a creature with the minion trait under your control
spells.notes: Shield your eidolon or minion from harm.

spells.name: Protection
spells.notes: Raise a creature's AC.

spells.name: Protective Wards
spells.notes: You expand a ring of glyphs that shields your allies.

spells.name: Protector Tree
spells.notes: Conjure a tree that guards allies.

spells.name: Protector's Sacrifice
spells.notes: You protect your ally by suffering in their stead.

spells.name: Protector's Sphere
spells.notes: A protective aura emanates out from you, safeguarding you and your allies.

spells.name: Proximal Shift
spells.notes: Teleport yourself and part of your surroundings around you somewhere else.

spells.name: Prying Survey
spells.notes: You create eight invisible, floating eyes, each about 3 inches in diameter, that scan the area around you, transmitting rough impressions of the environment.

spells.name: Psychic Outburst
spells.notes: Psychic energy explodes around you.

spells.name: Puff of Poison
spells.notes: Exhale toxins to poison a foe.

spells.name: Pulse of Civilization
spells.notes: You tap into the zeitgeist of any settlements in range.

spells.name: Pulverizing Cascade
spells.notes: You raise a pair of towering waves and slam them into each other, crushing creatures caught between them.
spells.source: Rage of Elements, Secrets of Magic

spells.name: Pulverizing Wake
spells.notes: Imitating raptorial creatures, you attack with such speed it drives a sonic shockwave.

spells.name: Pummeling Rubble
spells.notes: Hurl a cone of rocks to batter creatures.

spells.name: Punishing Winds
spells.notes: A cyclone inhibits flight and traps creatures.

spells.name: Puppet Strings
spells.notes: Manipulate your target with ethereal strings.

spells.name: Purging Toxins
spells.notes: In the right dose, a scourge can become a cure.

spells.name: Purifying Icicle
spells.notes: You evoke life essence into the form of water and freeze it, then launch the icicle at a foe.

spells.name: Purifying Veil
spells.notes: Drawing on the purifying powers of water, you call forth a veil of fine water droplets suffused with holy energy.

spells.name: Purple Worm Sting
spells.notes: Damage a creature and infect it with purple worm venom.

spells.name: Pushing Gust
spells.notes: Giving the air a push, you buffet the target with a powerful gust of wind; it must attempt a Fortitude save.

spells.name: Putrefy Food and Drink
spells.target: 1 cubic foot of clean food or water
spells.notes: You cause otherwise edible food to rot and spoil instantly, and water and other liquids to become brackish and undrinkable.

spells.name: Pyrefowl Rebuke
spells.notes: Fiery wings briefly envelop your arms, and with a swift wingbeat, you flutter away from your attacker in a shower of searing sparks.

spells.name: Pyroclastic Truth
spells.notes: The blast of liquid fire created by this spell brands the soul of those who are touched by its flames.

spells.name: Pyrotechnics
spells.notes: You turn a fire into either a burst of blinding fireworks or a thick cloud of choking smoke
spells.source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

spells.name: Qi Blast
spells.notes: You unleash your qi as a powerful blast that deals 2d6 force damage.

spells.name: Qi Form
spells.notes: Drawing from deep wells of spiritual power, you take on a special qi form.

spells.name: Qi Rush
spells.notes: Accelerated by your qi, you move with such speed you become a blur.

spells.name: Quandary
spells.notes: Trap a creature in an extradimensional puzzle.

spells.name: Quantic Dampening
spells.notes: You demonstrate exceptional control over elemental forces, allowing you to mitigate the effects of energy damage.

spells.name: Quench
spells.notes: Put out fires and hurt fire creatures.

spells.name: Quick Sort
spells.target: up to 200 unattended objects in range, each of light Bulk or less
spells.notes: Automatically sort many objects.

spells.name: Quicken Time
spells.notes: You speed up the time stream in an area, stretching and pulling it until time flows swift and wild.

spells.name: Radiant Beam
spells.notes: You fire a beam of blinding light from your outstretched hands.

spells.name: Radiant Field
spells.notes: You create an area of bright light .

spells.name: Radiant Globe
spells.notes: You create a dome of brilliant light that destroys projectiles attempting to pass through it.

spells.name: Radiant Heart of Devotion
spells.notes: You speak a fervent prayer for the heavens to assist you and your righteous allies.

spells.name: Rainbow Fumarole
spells.notes: Vent multicolored gases to burn and debilitate.

spells.name: Rainbow's End
spells.notes: You reach upward to wrest down a rainbow and harness its power to connect this world to the heavens.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.target: 1 dead creature of 13th level or lower
spells.notes: Return a dead creature to life.

spells.name: Rally Point
spells.notes: You mark the area touched as a rally point.

spells.name: Rallying Anthem
spells.notes: Your song moves allies to protect themselves more effectively.

spells.name: Rallying Banner
spells.notes: You create an illusory banner representing a revolution, social movement, or organization such as the Firebrands.

spells.name: Ranage's Circle
spells.notes: Many stories tell of a clearing deep in the Mwangi jungle, surrounded by ancient cypress trees

spells.name: Ranger's Bramble
spells.notes: You cause plants in the area to entangle your foes, with the effects of entangling flora .

spells.name: Rapid Adaptation
spells.notes: Adapt your companion or eidolon to your environment.

spells.name: Rapid Retreat
spells.notes: You know how to swiftly escape from harm.

spells.name: Ravening Maw
spells.notes: You evoke Zevgavizeb’s unceasing hunger and inflict it upon your target.

spells.name: Ravenous Darkness
spells.notes: You create a shroud of magical darkness that feeds on those inside it.

spells.name: Ravenous Portal
spells.target: 1 door no more than 10 feet tall and 5 feet wide
spells.notes: Door turns into a mimic when others try to open it.

spells.name: Ray of Corruption
spells.notes: You unleash a sickly gray beam of toxic spores at your target.
spells.source: Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower

spells.name: Read Aura
spells.notes: Detect if an object is magical.

spells.name: Read Fate
spells.notes: You attempt to learn more about the target's fate in the short term, usually within the next day for most prosaic creatures, or the next hour or less for someone likely to have multiple rapid experiences, such as someone actively adventuring.

spells.name: Read Omens
spells.notes: Get a piece of advice about an upcoming event.

spells.name: Read the Air
spells.notes: Pick up societal cues.

spells.name: Reanimate Foe
spells.notes: You launch a thrall up to 30 feet into the corpse of an enemy that has been dead for no more than 1 minute, destroying the thrall in an effort to call the corpse to fight.

spells.name: Reaper’s Lantern
spells.notes: A ghostly lantern diminishes healing for the living and weakens the undead.

spells.name: Reblooded
spells.notes: Fill an undead creature with toxic blood.

spells.name: Rebounding Barrier
spells.notes: You swiftly raise a reflective barrier, reducing physical damage and rebounding it onto your attacker.

spells.name: Rebuke Death
spells.target: 1 living creature per action spent to Cast this spell
spells.notes: You snatch creatures from the jaws of death, restoring them without the strain of a typical close call.

spells.name: Recall Legacy
spells.notes: You establish a mental link with the target, focusing on a piece of knowledge important to their culture, family (by birth or choice), or home settlement.

spells.name: Reclined Apport
spells.target: 1 unattended object of light Bulk or less
spells.notes: Walking over to an item to pick it up is so much effort.

spells.name: Recurring Nightmare
spells.notes: You conjure forth a ghostly thrall that isn’t easily slain. You create a thrall within range, and you can create it in a space occupied by a creature.

spells.name: Redact
spells.target: unattended written materials of up to 1 Bulk
spells.notes: You strike mention of a specific name from one or more documents.

spells.name: Redistribute Potential
spells.notes: Energy attempts to balance out, but with your magic, you can shunt all the energy in one area to another.

spells.name: Reed Whistle
spells.notes: You enchant a blade of grass that you can easily hold in your mouth without inhibiting your speech or other actions.

spells.name: Reflected Beauty
spells.notes: When you cast reflected beauty , choose a willing creature that’s the same size as you and that you can see within 30 feet.

spells.name: Reflective Scales
spells.notes: You grow a set of colored, glowing scales or scaled armor that stores energy before releasing it in a final burst.

spells.name: Regenerate
spells.notes: Creature heals over time, regrows organs, and reattaches body parts.

spells.name: Reinforce Eidolon
spells.notes: You focus deeply on the link between you and your eidolon and reinforce your eidolon’s defenses.

spells.name: Rejuvenating Flames
spells.notes: You create a gout of flame that both heals and burns.

spells.name: Remake
spells.notes: Recreate a destroyed object.

spells.name: Remake Physiology
spells.notes: Transform a creature’s body into an amalgam of mismatched animal parts.

spells.name: Remember the Lost
spells.notes: You call upon the lost and forgotten, assailing your foes’ minds with the memories of those who died with a grievance toward them.

spells.name: Rend Magic
spells.notes: Rend a creature’s connection to magic.

spells.name: Repel Metal
spells.target: the creature targeted by the triggering Strike
spells.notes: You call forth a repelling field.

spells.name: Repelling Pulse
spells.notes: Telekinetically knock creatures back and damage them with force.

spells.name: Replicate
spells.target: 1 willing or unconscious creature of 8th level or lower
spells.notes: Create an illusory duplicate of a creature.

spells.name: Repulsion
spells.notes: Prevent creatures from approaching you.

spells.name: Resist Energy
spells.notes: Protect a creature from one type of energy damage.

spells.name: Resplendent Mansion
spells.notes: Conjure a towering mansion.

spells.name: Restorative Moment
spells.notes: Your patron weaves the threads of time around the target, giving them some of the benefits of a day's passage.

spells.name: Restore Ground
spells.notes: You sense that this place yearns to throw off the shackles of civilization.

spells.name: Restraining Chains
spells.target: 1 creature touching or standing on a solid surface
spells.notes: Tie down a creature with a magical chain.

spells.name: Restyle
spells.target: 1 piece of clothing currently worn by you or an ally
spells.notes: Make permanent style changes to clothing.

spells.name: Retributive Pain
spells.notes: You vengefully reflect your pain upon your tormentor.

spells.name: Retrieving Hook
spells.target: 1 creature or an unattended object of 2 Bulk or less
spells.notes: Pull a creature toward you.

spells.name: Retrocognition
spells.notes: Sense impressions of past events at your location.

spells.name: Return Beacon
spells.notes: You create a unique planar beacon somewhere within the spell's range that remains in place.

spells.name: Return the Favor
spells.notes: You're unable to leave any debts unpaid.

spells.name: Return to Essence
spells.target: one magically sealed or warded doorway or chest
spells.notes: You unravel the magic of a spell that affects a container, door, or lock, converting it into energy you can repurpose to power your own spells.
spells.source: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star

spells.name: Revealing Light
spells.notes: Dazzling light counters invisibility and concealment.

spells.name: Revel in Retribution
spells.notes: Time seems to slow for you, allowing you to strike your opponents mid-move.

spells.name: Reverse Gravity
spells.notes: Flip the gravitational pull in an area.

spells.name: Revival
spells.target: dead creatures and living creatures of your choice within range
spells.notes: Heal creatures in an area and return the dead to life temporarily.

spells.name: Rewinding Step
spells.notes: Anchor your location in time so you can quickly return.

spells.name: Rewrite Memory
spells.notes: Alter, erase, or implant memories.

spells.name: Rewrite Possibility
spells.notes: You continually glimpse into the target's future and nudge fate to guide them toward the best possible outcome.

spells.name: Rigid Form
spells.notes: Protect against polymorph effects.

spells.name: Rime Slick
spells.notes: You call down a chill wind.
spells.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

spells.name: Ring of Truth
spells.notes: Ring a bell when the truth is spoken.

spells.name: Rip the Spirit
spells.notes: Tear at a living creature’s spirit with void energy to damage and drain it.

spells.name: Rising Surf
spells.notes: You create a wave of water that you ride, banking around obstacles and surfing to higher ground.
spells.source: Rage of Elements, Secrets of Magic

spells.name: Ritual Obstruction
spells.notes: You establish a zone of magical feedback that makes it impossible to succeed at rituals of this spell's level or lower in the area.

spells.name: River Carving Mountains
spells.notes: Your apparition solidifies around you into roaring water and spraying mist.

spells.name: Roar of the Dragon
spells.notes: You channel the might of dragons into your voice, letting out a roar that engenders respect in dragonkind but that instills fear in most other creatures.

spells.name: Roaring Applause
spells.notes: Force the target to cheer and applaud you.

spells.name: Root Reading
spells.notes: Learn about an area using root systems.

spells.name: Rose's Thorns
spells.notes: Rose bushes with razor-sharp thorns sprout from the ground in the area.

spells.name: Rouse Skeletons
spells.notes: Rouse a squadron of skeletons to claw foes.

spells.name: Rousing Splash
spells.notes: Splash a creature to invigorate it and wash away acid and fire.

spells.name: Rubble Step
spells.notes: Have an ally leave rubble as it moves.

spells.name: Rune of Observation
spells.notes: You inscribe an invisible eye-shaped rune in the air, creating a sensor as clairvoyance .

spells.name: Runic Body
spells.notes: Temporarily apply magical runes to a creature's unarmed attacks.

spells.name: Runic Impression
spells.target: you or one weapon you’re wielding
spells.notes: Your unarmed attacks or your weapon gain the benefits of a weapon rune you choose.

spells.name: Runic Weapon
spells.target: 1 weapon that is unattended or wielded by a willing creature
spells.notes: Temporarily apply magical runes to a weapon.

spells.name: Rust Cloud
spells.notes: Make a cloud of rusty flecks that cuts creatures and rusts metal.

spells.name: Rusting Grasp
spells.target: 1 metal creature, 1 non-magical metal hazard, or 1 non-magical metal item of up to 1 Bulk
spells.notes: Rapidly rust metal.

spells.name: Sacred Beasts
spells.notes: You call out to the creatures of the wild favored by your deity.

spells.name: Sacred Covenant
spells.target: you and up to 5 willing creatures
spells.notes: Create a sacred pact with your allies that could save their lives.

spells.name: Sacred Form
spells.notes: Transform into a battle form with sacred armaments.

spells.name: Sacred Nimbus
spells.notes: You summon a small, fluffy white nimbus cloud that floats 10 feet above the ground and rains down pleasantly warm sanctified water.

spells.name: Safe Passage
spells.notes: Make an area safe to move through.

spells.name: Safeguard Secret
spells.target: you and any number of willing allies
spells.notes: You ensure a secret remains safe from prying spies.

spells.name: Sage's Curse
spells.notes: You afflict the target with a curse that fills its mind with distracting and hyperspecialized minutiae, causing it to second-guess even simple facts.
spells.source: Abomination Vaults Hardcover, Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.notes: Protect a creature from being attacked.

spells.name: Sand Form
spells.notes: Turn a creature’s body and gear into sand.

spells.name: Sanguine Mist
spells.notes: Create a cloud of life-draining fog.

spells.name: Sanguine Transference
spells.notes: You diffuse your spirit into your blood before escaping your body and transferring your blood and soul into a thrall. You use the target thrall to reform your body in its space, and you leave a thrall where your body once was.

spells.name: Savor the Sting
spells.notes: You inflict pain upon the target and revel in their anguish.

spells.name: Sawtooth Terrain
spells.notes: You cause long, serrated mantis limbs to appear.

spells.name: Scatter Scree
spells.notes: Evoke rocks to bludgeon and create difficult terrain.

spells.name: Schadenfreude
spells.notes: Distract foes with their exultation at your failure.

spells.name: Scholarly Recollection
spells.notes: Speaking a short prayer as you gather your thoughts, you're blessed to find yourself pointed in the right direction.

spells.name: Scintillating Safeguard
spells.target: up to 5 willing creatures who would be harmed by the triggering effect
spells.notes: Reactively form a protective barrier.

spells.name: Scorching Blast
spells.notes: You evoke a mass of fire into the air around your outstretched fist.

spells.name: Scouring Pulse
spells.notes: You inundate the area with concentrated positive energy, which scours away the stain of undeath.

spells.name: Scouring Sand
spells.notes: You blast the area with grit that scours away soil and gets into creatures’ eyes.
spells.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

spells.name: Scouting Eye
spells.notes: Invisible eye transmits what it sees to you.

spells.name: Scramble Body
spells.notes: Your magic throws the creature's biology into disarray, inducing nausea, fever, and other unpleasant conditions.

spells.name: Scrounger's Glee
spells.notes: With a cruel laugh and a flash of your canines, you make a target understand that death is coming to claim it and that its demise will serve to strengthen another.

spells.name: Scrying
spells.notes: Spy on a creature you choose.

spells.name: Scrying Ripples
spells.notes: Scry from one body of water into another.

spells.name: Sculpt Sound
spells.notes: Quiet or alter the sound from a creature or object.

spells.name: Sea of Thought
spells.notes: You cover the area in a sloshing torrent of semi-solidified thought, roughly ankle high.

spells.name: Sea Surge
spells.notes: You slap or stomp on a nearby solid or liquid surface, sending a surge of water rushing away from you.
spells.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

spells.name: Seal Fate
spells.notes: Curse a creature to be harmed by a type of damage.

spells.name: Seashell of Stolen Sound
spells.notes: Copy a sound in a magical seashell.

spells.name: Secret Page
spells.target: 1 page up to 3 square feet in size
spells.notes: Alter the appearance of a page.

spells.name: See the Unseen
spells.notes: Reveal invisible creatures to your sight.

spells.name: Seize Identity
spells.notes: With a gleeful cackle, you seize an individual's voice and swallow it.

spells.name: Seize Soul
spells.target: 1 creature that died within the last minute
spells.notes: Trap a soul in an item.

spells.name: Sending
spells.notes: Send a message to a creature anywhere on the planet and get a reply.

spells.name: Sepulchral Mask
spells.notes: You manifest a supernatural funerary mask, granting you a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws against emotion effects for 1 minute.

spells.name: Serrate
spells.notes: With a pinch, the metal of a weapon twists, adding numerous jagged blades along its surface.

spells.name: Shadow Army
spells.notes: yourself to have your shadows fight enemies as you hide among them.

spells.name: Shadow Blast
spells.notes: Shape a damaging cone of shadow substance to deal damage of a type you choose.

spells.name: Shadow Illusion
spells.notes: You create a shadowy illusion of a creature or a stationary object, but the illusion can exist only in an area of dim light or darkness.

spells.name: Shadow Jump
spells.notes: You instantly transport yourself from one shadow to another.

spells.name: Shadow Projectile
spells.notes: The shadow of an ally’s attack becomes real.

spells.name: Shadow Raid
spells.notes: A swarm of illusory shadows damages foes in the area and provides concealment.

spells.name: Shadow Siphon
spells.notes: React to lessen the damage from an enemy's spell by making it partially illusion.

spells.name: Shadow Spy
spells.notes: You mix blood, soil, and shadow together to form a half-real homunculus in the shape of a crow, sparrow, or other bird.

spells.name: Shadow Strike
spells.notes: Attack with a tendril of darkness.

spells.name: Shadow Zombie
spells.notes: You cast a shadow over the target zombie, briefly turning it into shadowy vapor and controlling its movement.

spells.name: Shadow's Web
spells.notes: Grasping darkness surges from you, dealing 14d4 void damage.

spells.name: Shaken Confidence
spells.notes: You mock the target for all its failings, twisting its self- confidence into doubt.

spells.name: Shall Not Falter, Shall Not Rout
spells.notes: Calling out the fifth line of the Crimson Oath, you seal your most grievous injuries with a stroke of your blade.

spells.name: Shambling Horror
spells.target: 1 corpse of a Gargantuan or smaller creature that has a level no greater than your level – 4 and has died since the last sunrise
spells.notes: You reanimate the corpse of a fallen creature as an undead minion under your control.

spells.name: Shape Stone
spells.target: cube of stone 10 feet across or smaller
spells.notes: Reshape a cube of stone.

spells.name: Shape Wood
spells.target: an unworked piece of wood up to 20 cubic feet in volume
spells.notes: Transform unworked wood into a shape of your choice.

spells.name: Share Burden
spells.notes: You shoulder some of your ally’s pain.

spells.name: Share Life
spells.notes: Absorb half the damage another would take.

spells.name: Share Lore
spells.notes: You share your knowledge with the touched creatures.

spells.name: Share Vision
spells.notes: Your patron temporarily links your vision with that of another, causing both of you to be able to see through each other’s eyes.

spells.name: Shared Invisibility
spells.target: you and up to 5 willing creatures
spells.notes: You and nearby creatures become invisible.

spells.name: Shared Nightmare
spells.notes: Merging minds with the target, you swap distressing visions.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.notes: Shatter an object with a high-frequency sonic attack.

spells.name: Shatter Mind
spells.notes: You telepathically assail the minds of your foes.

spells.name: Shattering Gem
spells.notes: A large gem floats around the target in an erratic pattern.

spells.name: Sheltering Wings
spells.notes: Like migratory birds, you know everyone flies farther together.

spells.name: Shepherd of Souls
spells.notes: You stay the hand of fate for one not yet destined to die, sacrificing some of your own vitality to heal them.

spells.name: Shield
spells.notes: A shield of magical force blocks attacks and spells.

spells.name: Shielded Arm
spells.notes: Reinforce a creature’s arm with metal that lets it use its arm as a shield.

spells.name: Shielding Formation
spells.notes: You conjure magical shields of force to protect your allies around you.

spells.name: Shielding Strike
spells.notes: As you attack a foe, warding magic transforms your momentum into action and lifts your shield.

spells.name: Shields of the Spirit
spells.notes: You Raise your Shield , causing ephemeral spirit shields to float within your champion's aura.

spells.name: Shift Blame
spells.target: the target of the triggering attack or skill check
spells.notes: Trick someone into thinking someone else is to blame for your attack or blunder.

spells.name: Shift Perspective
spells.notes: See through a small object you throw.

spells.name: Shifting Form
spells.notes: You change your body to better suit the moment.

spells.name: Shifting Sand
spells.notes: You cause the surface to heave.

spells.name: Shillelagh
spells.notes: Make a club or staff temporarily magical, and deal more damage to unnatural creatures.

spells.name: Shining Starlight Attack
spells.notes: You brandish your sentinel weapon, summoning the image of your constellation above your head.

spells.name: Shipwreck
spells.notes: You gesture toward a vehicle and the vessel wrenches itself apart.

spells.name: Shock and Awe
spells.notes: You create the illusion of cannons exploding, bullets and arrows flying, and magical ballistics firing, as an overwhelming torrent of information, both visual and auditory.

spells.name: Shock to the System
spells.target: 1 living creature or 1 corpse that died within the last round
spells.notes: Lightning revives and revitalizes.

spells.name: Shockwave
spells.notes: You create a wave of energy that ripples through the earth.

spells.name: Shooting Star
spells.notes: You let loose a projectile that flies true and leaves the blazing trail of a meteor behind it.

spells.name: Show the Path
spells.notes: You grant the target insight on things to come, guiding them toward a fate they find most fitting and encouraging them to continue this journey.

spells.name: Show The Way
spells.notes: You and allies in the area gain preternatural knowledge of the path ahead, allowing you to intuit the best way forward and avoid potential obstacles, such as difficult or confusing terrain.

spells.name: Shrink
spells.notes: Reduce a willing creature to Tiny size.

spells.name: Shrink Item
spells.target: 1 non-magical object up to 20 cubic feet in volume and up to 80 Bulk
spells.notes: Reduce an object to the size of a coin.

spells.name: Shrink the Span
spells.notes: The world seems to shrink before your footfalls.

spells.name: Shroud of Flame
spells.notes: You encircle yourself in an aura of protective flames.

spells.name: Shroud of Night
spells.notes: Your patron blankets the target's eyes in darkness.

spells.name: Shroud of the Mantis
spells.notes: You wrap yourself in a crimson cloak that renders you invisible.

spells.name: Siege Weapon's Blessing
spells.notes: You trace a magic rune onto the body of a siege weapon, calling upon fate or your faith to guide the attacks your allies make with this machine.

spells.name: Sigil
spells.notes: Leave a magical mark.

spells.name: Sign of Conviction
spells.notes: You conjure the religious symbol of your deity into the air above you in the same space you stand in, wielding the power of your faith to smite your foes.

spells.name: Signal Skyrocket
spells.notes: Send an exploding firework straight up into the sky.

spells.name: Silence
spells.notes: Mute all sound from a willing creature.

spells.name: Silver's Refrain
spells.notes: Make weapons silver and impede a devil's teleportation.

spells.name: Skeletal Lancers
spells.notes: You conjure a force of skeletons wielding bony spears.

spells.name: Skeleton Army
spells.notes: With a fistful of compressed bones, you summon a legion of skeletal hulks to fight in your war, refusing to let them rest until they’ve given up their last inches of usefulness to your cause.

spells.name: Sky Laughs at Waves
spells.notes: You soar and leave the world’s squabbles behind before your violent intentions ground you once more.

spells.name: Sky Sight
spells.notes: See the sky, wherever you might be.

spells.name: Skyglass Prison
spells.notes: Solidify air into a glassy prison.

spells.name: Slashing Gust
spells.notes: Cut creatures with ripples of air.

spells.name: Sleep

spells.name: Sliding Blocks
spells.notes: Make cubes of stone and repeatedly move them around.

spells.name: Slime Spit

spells.name: Slither
spells.notes: Shadowy snakes bite and capture creatures.

spells.name: Slough Skin
spells.notes: You continually and harmlessly slough off the top layer of your skin while new skin regenerates immediately, quickly moving damaging substances away from your body.

spells.name: Slow

spells.name: Snake Fangs
spells.notes: Your jaw unhinges as your teeth extend into wicked fangs.

spells.name: Snare Hopping
spells.notes: You may not have placed your snare in the right place, but you can magically move it there.

spells.name: Snowball
spells.notes: You throw a magically propelled and chilled ball of dense snow.

spells.name: Soft Landing
spells.notes: You create a magical field that buoys any creature or object falling into the area.

spells.name: Solid Fog
spells.notes: Conjure heavy fog that obscures sight and is hard to move through.

spells.name: Sonata Span
spells.notes: Manifest a path with a tune.

spells.name: Song of Marching
spells.notes: You maintain a brisk performance that keeps allies on the move.

spells.name: Song of Strength
spells.notes: You bolster your allies' physical strength with a hearty exhortation.

spells.name: Song of the Fallen
spells.target: up to 4 dead creatures or up to 4 undead creatures
spells.notes: Rouse the dead or smite the undead.

spells.name: Song of the Soul
spells.notes: You shape a thrall into an instrument that plays a silent song that can be heard by only one soul.

spells.name: Songbird's Call
spells.notes: Your voice calls a storm of songbirds that whirl around you and peck at your enemies.

spells.name: Soothe
spells.notes: Heal the target and bolster them against mental attacks.

spells.name: Soothing Ballad
spells.notes: You draw upon your muse to soothe your allies.

spells.name: Soothing Blossoms
spells.notes: Flowers assist recovery from persistent damage and afflictions.

spells.name: Soothing Mist
spells.target: 1 willing living creature or 1 undead creature
spells.notes: You call forth a magical mist that envelops a creature.

spells.name: Soothing Spring
spells.notes: Create a rejuvenating hot spring.

spells.name: Soothing Words
spells.notes: You attempt to calm the target by uttering soothing words in a calm and even tone.

spells.name: Soul Cutter
spells.notes: Cut the very soul of your enemy.

spells.name: Soul Siphon
spells.notes: You siphon off a portion of the target's soul to bolster your own vitality.

spells.name: Soulshelter Vessel
spells.target: 1 willing creature and 1 non-magical stone object of 1 or 2 Bulk
spells.notes: You connect the spirit of the target creature with the target object, giving their spirit a durable vessel that protects and empowers their body.

spells.name: Sound Body
spells.notes: Counteract blinded, dazzled, deafened, enfeebled, sickened, and related conditions.

spells.name: Space Fold Gate
spells.notes: Gate Fold space to connect two distant spaces.

spells.name: Sparkleskin
spells.notes: You coat a creature's body in a layer of brilliantly sparkling glitter.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.notes: Communicate with animals.

spells.name: Speak with Magic
spells.notes: Ask questions of a spell or magic item.

spells.name: Speak with Plants
spells.notes: Communicate with plants and plant creatures.

spells.name: Speak with Stones
spells.notes: Communicate with natural and worked stone.

spells.name: Speak with Water
spells.notes: Ask questions of a body of water or the rain.

spells.name: Speaking Sky
spells.notes: The air speaks to you.
spells.source: Impossible Lands, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under

spells.name: Spectral Advance
spells.notes: Taking on a spiritual form, you flash across the battlefield to engage an enemy.

spells.name: Spectral Blade
spells.notes: Throw spectral blades that always return to your hands.

spells.name: Spell Immunity
spells.notes: Name a spell to negate its effects on you.

spells.name: Spell Riposte
spells.notes: Reflect a spell targeted at you.

spells.name: Spellmaster's Ward
spells.notes: You create one or more glowing protective runes that revolve around you.

spells.name: Spellsurge
spells.notes: Magic surges to life around you, feeding on the raw power you radiate.

spells.name: Spellwrack
spells.notes: Curse a creature to be harmed when a spell is cast on it and lower the duration of its spells.

spells.name: Spider Sting
spells.notes: Damage a creature and afflict it with spider venom.

spells.name: Spike Stones
spells.notes: Grow sharp spikes out of the ground.

spells.name: Spiked Carapace
spells.notes: Your arm becomes a bony weapon.

spells.name: Spinning Staff
spells.notes: You spin your staff with an impossibly quick twirling flourish, attacking two foes and transforming the momentum into magical energy to charge for your next Spellstrike.

spells.name: Spiral of Horrors
spells.notes: Shades and spirits howl and whirl around you in a display that strikes fear into the hearts of all who witness it.

spells.name: Spirit Blast
spells.notes: Damage a creature's spiritual essence.

spells.name: Spirit Link
spells.notes: Continually transfer your health to someone else.

spells.name: Spirit Object
spells.notes: Using a sliver of Baba Yaga ’s power, you briefly bring a nearby object to life.

spells.name: Spirit of the Beast
spells.notes: You bring out the spirit of another animal that lives within your companion.

spells.name: Spirit Sense
spells.notes: Detect spirits and haunts.

spells.name: Spirit Song
spells.notes: Sing a song that damages any creature with a spirit.

spells.name: Spirit Veil
spells.notes: You draw an occluding veil of spirits around yourself, blocking yourself especially well from undead eyes.

spells.name: Spirit Ward
spells.notes: You draw on nearby spiritual energy or on echoes of the spirits you’ve invoked throughout your life to temporarily ward living flesh against dangerous spirits.

spells.name: Spiritual Anamnesis
spells.notes: Overwhelm a target with memories of a past life.

spells.name: Spiritual Armament
spells.notes: Project a weapon imbued with spiritual power.

spells.name: Spiritual Attunement
spells.notes: Attune to an aligned plane to protect yourself and harm creatures opposed to that plane.

spells.name: Spiritual Epidemic
spells.notes: Weaken a target with a communicable curse.

spells.name: Spiritual Guardian
spells.notes: Create a magical guardian to attack at your command and take damage for your allies.

spells.name: Spiritual Renewal
spells.notes: You draw upon the restorative power of the spirits around you.

spells.name: Spiritual Torrent
spells.notes: You release your spiritual essence in a torrential blast of energy, dealing 10d6 damage.

spells.name: Spiritual Transport
spells.notes: You call upon the spiritual energies surrounding you to teleport you to an unoccupied space within range that you can see.

spells.name: Splinter Volley
spells.notes: Fling sharp splinters at one or more enemies.

spells.name: Split the Tongue
spells.notes: The deceiving creature's tongue splits like a serpent's tongue.
spells.source: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale

spells.name: Spontaneous Cartography
spells.notes: Create a simple map of the area.

spells.name: Spout
spells.notes: Batter creatures with a water blast.

spells.name: Spray of Stars
spells.notes: You fling a spray of tiny shooting stars, dealing 2d4 fire damage.

spells.name: Spy's Mark
spells.target: a wall or other solid, immobile surface
spells.notes: By pressing your hand to a wall or other solid immobile surface, you cause the crossed-swords symbol of the Firebrands—or a different symbol of your choosing—to appear on the targeted surface.

spells.name: Stabilize
spells.notes: Stabilize a dying creature.

spells.name: Stagnate Time
spells.notes: You examine the time stream in a particular area, then proceed to stick a few metaphorical pins into it, thickening and slowing down the flow of time until it rumbles along like a river of molasses.

spells.name: Stars of Another Sky
spells.notes: Sky Drag your enemies into the River of Souls.

spells.name: Stasis
spells.target: 1 creature or up to 1 Bulk of objects
spells.notes: The flow of time congeals around an object or creature, holding it in place.

spells.name: Status
spells.notes: Keep track of a willing creature's location and wellbeing.

spells.name: Steal Shadow
spells.notes: You steal a creature's shadow, leaving it weakened and vulnerable.

spells.name: Steal the Sky
spells.notes: You deny a flying creature the support of the air.
spells.source: Impossible Lands, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under

spells.name: Steal Voice
spells.notes: You steal a creature's voice, rendering them mute.

spells.name: Steel Fortifications
spells.notes: You conjure several metal structures that consist of angled beams attached to one another at a central point, which can help block attacks.

spells.name: Stick On
spells.notes: Stick yourself to a creature or object.

spells.name: Sticky Fire
spells.notes: You send a bubble of viscous liquid that sparks into flame.

spells.name: Stifling Stillness
spells.notes: Make air hard to breathe and traverse.

spells.name: Sting of the Sea
spells.notes: A long tentacle like that belonging to an octopus, anemone, or man-of-war, dripping with briny water, appears from a glowing blue portal to wrap around the target’s face, blocking its vision.

spells.name: Stinking Cloud
spells.notes: Form a cloud that sickens creatures.

spells.name: Stoke the Heart
spells.notes: Your patron fills a creature with fervor, empowering their blows.

spells.name: Stone Lance
spells.notes: You conjure a jagged lance of stone and then launch it at a foe.
spells.source: Rage of Elements, Secrets of Magic

spells.name: Stone to Flesh
spells.target: petrified creature or human-size stone object
spells.notes: Turn a creature turned to stone back to flesh.

spells.name: Stonesense
spells.notes: You can tremorsense
spells.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

spells.name: Stop Heart
spells.notes: Squeeze the heart of an adjacent enemy.

spells.name: Store Time
spells.notes: You store time for later use.

spells.name: Storm Lord
spells.notes: The sky above you darkens in a matter of moments, swirling with ominous clouds punctuated by flashes of lighting.

spells.name: Stormburst
spells.notes: Your voice projects like cracking thunder as you summon a localized storm, creating a fearsome surge of lightning and wind.

spells.name: Stormwind Flight
spells.notes: Powerful winds carry you through the air, giving you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

spells.name: Strange Geometry
spells.notes: Confoundingly warp spatial geometry, making passage difficult and destinations unpredictable.

spells.name: Strength of Mind
spells.notes: You bolster your ally with reminders of their physical prowess, granting them additional defenses against harmful mental effects.

spells.name: String of Fate
spells.notes: You bond yourself to a cherished friend, vowing to share their fate for good or for ill.

spells.name: Stumbling Curse
spells.notes: With a twist of a finger, you send a creature careening on a haphazard trajectory.

spells.name: Stupefy
spells.notes: Dull a target's mind and make spell casting unreliable.

spells.name: Subconscious Suggestion
spells.notes: Plant a suggestion in a creature's mind that is must follow when a trigger occurs.

spells.name: Subjugate Undead
spells.target: one undead creature with a level of no more than your level - 4
spells.notes: You attempt to seize control of the target undead.

spells.name: Sudden Blight
spells.notes: Decay living creatures and plants.

spells.name: Sudden Bolt
spells.notes: You call down a small bolt of lightning on the target
spells.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

spells.name: Sudden Recollection
spells.notes: Plant information in a creature's subconscious to be revealed on a trigger you choose.

spells.name: Sudden Shift
spells.notes: You swiftly move from a dangerous spot and veil yourself.

spells.name: Sudden Swarm
spells.notes: Turn your familiar into a biting swarm.

spells.name: Sudden Transposition
spells.notes: You wrench the targets off their feet, forcefully teleporting them within the area.

spells.name: Suffocate
spells.target: 1 living creature that needs to breathe
spells.notes: You forcefully and cruelly draw the living breath from a creature's lungs, dealing 4d8 bludgeoning damage.

spells.name: Suggestion
spells.notes: Suggest a course of action a creature must follow.

spells.name: Summon Anarch
spells.notes: Summon a chaotic celestial, monitor, or fiend.

spells.name: Summon Ancient Fleshforged

spells.name: Summon Animal
spells.notes: Conjure an animal to fight for you.

spells.name: Summon Axiom
spells.notes: Summon a lawful celestial, monitor, or fiend.

spells.name: Summon Celestial
spells.notes: Conjure a celestial to fight for you.

spells.name: Summon Construct
spells.notes: Conjure a construct to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Dragon
spells.notes: Conjure a dragon to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Elemental
spells.notes: Conjure an elemental to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Elemental Herald
spells.notes: Summon an incarnate elemental to create a natural disaster.

spells.name: Summon Entity
spells.notes: Conjure an aberration to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.notes: Conjure a fey to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Fiend
spells.notes: Conjure a fiend to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Giant
spells.notes: Conjure a giant to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Healing Servitor
spells.notes: You call forth a servitor forged from raw positive energy to heal and bolster your allies.

spells.name: Summon Instrument
spells.notes: Call an instrument that only you can play.

spells.name: Summon Irii
spells.notes: You cast your spell, whisper your words of power, and find that an irii is already here.

spells.name: Summon Lesser Servitor
spells.notes: Summon a minor celestial, monitor, or fiend.

spells.name: Summon Monitor
spells.notes: Conjure a planar monitor to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Plant or Fungus
spells.notes: Conjure a plant or fungus to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Stampede
spells.notes: You summon an unstoppable stampede of panicking beasts.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.notes: Conjure an undead to fight on your behalf.

spells.name: Summon Warden of the Wild
spells.notes: You briefly call forth the spirit of one of the Wardens of the Wild, the legendary guardians of nature.

spells.name: Summoner's Precaution
spells.notes: Set a contingency to avoid being knocked out alongside your eidolon.

spells.name: Summoner's Visage
spells.notes: Change your eidolon to cosmetically appear to be your identical twin.

spells.name: Sun Blade
spells.notes: Launch a bolt of divine sunfire.

spells.name: Sun's Fury
spells.target: 1 weapon without an unholy rune that is unattended or wielded by you or a willing ally
spells.notes: The target weapon becomes wreathed in a glowing flame.

spells.name: Sunburst
spells.notes: A globe of sunlight deals fire damage, hurts undead, and overcomes darkness.

spells.name: Sure Footing
spells.notes: Counteract clumsy, grabbed, paralyzed, or related conditions.

spells.name: Sure Strike
spells.notes: Your next attack is especially accurate.

spells.name: Suspended Retribution
spells.notes: All life dances one step from the precipice, one heartbeat from disaster.

spells.name: Swallow Light
spells.notes: You draw magical light into your open mouth, consuming it and turning its essence into fuel for a gout of life-draining shadows.

spells.name: Swamp of Sloth
spells.notes: Ground in the area turns swampy and fetid.

spells.name: Swampcall
spells.notes: You call upon the spirits of the soil to twist and churn, transforming the terrain in the targeted area into a sodden mess.

spells.name: Swarm Form
spells.notes: You discorporate into a swarm of Tiny creatures.

spells.name: Swarming Wasp Stings
spells.notes: You manifest a swarm of disembodied wasp stingers that stab creatures in the area, possibly poisoning them.
spells.source: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

spells.name: Swarmsense
spells.notes: You extend your senses through a multitude of crawling and flying creatures.

spells.name: Swear Oath
spells.notes: You loudly and firmly state a course of action that you swear to fulfill.

spells.name: Sweet Dream
spells.notes: With soothing words, you lull the target into an enchanting dream.

spells.name: Symphony of the Unfettered Heart
spells.notes: Your symphony lifts listeners from their worldly concerns.

spells.name: Synaptic Pulse
spells.notes: Slow creatures with a mental blast.

spells.name: Synchronize
spells.notes: Place sigils on your targets that flash at a prespecified time.

spells.name: Synchronize Steps
spells.notes: You link the minds of two targets, enabling them to move in tandem.

spells.name: Synesthesia
spells.notes: Rewire a creature’s senses.

spells.name: Tacky Pine Sap
spells.notes: Throw flammable sap onto the ground.

spells.name: Tailwind
spells.notes: Increase your speed for an hour.

spells.name: Take its Course
spells.notes: When someone has overindulged, you can hasten them past the worst of their affliction or intensify their misery.

spells.name: Take Root
spells.notes: Reinforce a creature’s stance or grip with roots.

spells.name: Take Your Places
spells.notes: The scene would play out exactly as you envisioned it, if only the actors would respect their blocking.

spells.name: Talking Corpse
spells.notes: Have a corpse answer three questions.

spells.name: Tame
spells.notes: Make a domesticated animal friendlier to you.

spells.name: Tangle Vine
spells.notes: Conjure a vine to entangle a creature.

spells.name: Tanglecurse
spells.notes: Tanglebriar has been called a “curse on the land,” which has inspired Treerazer’s cult to develop this notorious spell.
spells.source: Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower

spells.name: Tangling Creepers
spells.notes: Entangle creatures in a burst and concentrate to lash out with immobilizing vines.

spells.name: Tear the Veil
spells.notes: Create a rift to the Void that sucks in living creatures.

spells.name: Teeth to Terror
spells.notes: The target believes its teeth are falling out, crawling along its face, stabbing into its body, and cramming themselves down its throat.

spells.name: Telekinetic Bombardment
spells.notes: You grasp a piece of the landscape—such as a tree, carriage, or piece of masonry—and lob it in your foe's direction.

spells.name: Telekinetic Hand
spells.target: 1 unattended object of Light bulk or less
spells.notes: Move an object with a floating hand.

spells.name: Telekinetic Haul
spells.target: 1 unattended object of up to 80 Bulk with no dimension longer than 20 feet
spells.notes: Move a large object.

spells.name: Telekinetic Maneuver
spells.notes: Disarm, Reposition, Shove, or Trip a creature telekinetically.

spells.name: Telekinetic Projectile
spells.notes: Fling an object at a creature.

spells.name: Telekinetic Rend
spells.notes: Your mind creates a violent axis of motion in a nearby space that can smash or sever at your will.

spells.name: Telepathic Bond

spells.notes: Link minds with willing creatures to communicate telepathically at great distances.

spells.name: Telepathic Demand
spells.notes: Impel a creature with a mental message.

spells.name: Telepathy

spells.notes: Protect a creature with swirling winds.

spells.name: Tempest Form
spells.notes: Your body becomes fluid.

spells.notes: You surround a foe in a swirling storm of violent winds, roiling clouds, and crackling lightning.

spells.name: Temporal Twin
spells.notes: You pull a fleeting duplicate of your ally from the recent past

spells.source: Pathfinder #173: Doorway to the Red Star

spells.name: Temporary Glyph
spells.notes: Quickly scribe a short-lived glyph to blast foes.

spells.name: Temporary Tool
spells.notes: You conjure a temporary simple tool , such as a shovel or rope into your hands.

spells.name: Tempt Fate

spells.name: Tentacular Innervation
spells.notes: Grab an enemy with sickening tentacles.

spells.name: Tentacular Limbs
spells.notes: Your arms turn into long, pliable tentacles, increasing your reach when you're delivering touch range spells and making unarmed Strikes with your arms (such as fist and claw Strikes) to 10 feet.

spells.name: Terrain Transposition
spells.notes: You mystically transpose your current location with another.

spells.name: Tesseract Tunnel
spells.notes: You race from point to point, tearing open a tunnel in space.

spells.name: Tether
spells.notes: You use magical chains, vines, or other tethers to bind your target to you.

spells.name: The Everfull Moon
spells.notes: You call upon the secret moon, who’s always whole, to shine upon yourself, granting you the form of a mighty werewolf without letting the curse touch you.

spells.name: The Four Hunters
spells.notes: This is a story of four evenly matched hunters who sought to capture a falling star.

spells.name: The Parrot's Whisper
spells.notes: You call forth an echo of the gossiping parrot from the tale of the Witch and the Weave.

spells.name: The Queen's Rainbow
spells.notes: You tell the story of the Queen of Bees and her retinue trying to pass through a rainbow on their way to visit the King of Spiders.

spells.name: Theogeny
spells.notes: Create your own personal divine realm.

spells.name: Thermal Remedy
spells.target: up to 1 gallon of non-magical liquid or up to 5 pounds of food
spells.notes: Adjust ingredients in food and drink for health benefits.

spells.name: Thermal Stasis
spells.notes: The same abilities that let you raise or lower thermal energy also let you keep it at a safe medium.

spells.name: Thicket of Knives
spells.notes: Illusory copies of your weapon arm improve your ability to feint.

spells.name: Thoughtful Gift
spells.notes: Teleport an item to an ally’s grasp.

spells.name: Thrall Charge
spells.notes: You urge a thrall to move and attack.

spells.name: Threatening Mimicry
spells.notes: You appear larger and stronger to nearby creatures, appearing to possess threatening features like antlers, claws, or poison to their senses.

spells.name: Threefold Aspect

spells.name: Threefold Limb
spells.notes: You temporarily transform one of your limbs into water, taking the form of ice, liquid water, or steam as you desire.

spells.name: Thunder Echo
spells.notes: Discharge a loud burst of electrostatic that helps reveal secrets.

spells.name: Thunderburst
spells.notes: You create a powerful blast of air and a loud peal of thunder, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage and 2d6 sonic damage.

spells.name: Thundering Dominance
spells.notes: Make your companion or eidolon intimidating, and let it emit a sonic roar.

spells.name: Thunderous Strike
spells.notes: You swing your massive weapon, creating a wave of sonic vibrations that topples creatures.

spells.name: Thunderstrike
spells.notes: Call down a thunderbolt.

spells.name: Tidal Surge
spells.notes: You call forth a tremendous wave to move the target either in a body of water or on the ground.

spells.name: Timber
spells.notes: Drop a tree on someone.

spells.name: Time Beacon
spells.notes: You create a beacon in time to return to it if things go wrong

spells.name: Time Jump
spells.notes: Leap forward in time, moving swiftly.

spells.name: Time Pocket

spells.notes: You fling the target item forward in time and link it to the future of the creature holding it.

spells.name: Time Sense
