spells.name: Time Skip
spells.notes: You manipulate time around your ally, pushing them forward a few moments in time.

spells.name: Timely Reminder
spells.notes: Send a message to your future self.

spells.name: Timely Tutor
spells.notes: Connect your eidolon or familiar to the Akashic Record to briefly grant it knowledge.

spells.name: Tiny Wings
spells.notes: Grow a small pair of wings on your familiar.

spells.name: Tireless Worker
spells.notes: You suppress your choice of one of the following conditions that’s affecting the target: clumsy , encumbered , enfeebled , or fatigued .
spells.source: Divine Mysteries, Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

spells.name: Tomorrow's Dawn
spells.notes: The golden light of a new dawn and the promise of life beyond death radiates from your body.

spells.name: Tornadic Gale
spells.notes: Pull creatures into a small tornado.

spells.name: Tortoise and the Hare
spells.target: 1 foe, and either yourself or 1 ally
spells.notes: Quicken an ally and slow a foe.

spells.name: Torturous Trauma
spells.notes: You batter a creature's internal organs, leaving no external signs of the immense pain you delivered.

spells.name: Touch of Corruption
spells.target: 1 willing undead creature or 1 living creature
spells.notes: The antipaladin infuses the target with negative energy.

spells.name: Touch of Death
spells.notes: Make a melee unarmed Strike.

spells.name: Touch of Obedience
spells.notes: Your imperious touch erodes the target's willpower, making it easier to control.

spells.name: Touch of the Moon
spells.notes: When you touch the target, a symbol of the moon appears on its forehead, glowing with soft moonlight.

spells.name: Touch of the Void
spells.target: 1 willing undead creature or 1 living creature
spells.notes: You infuse the target with void energy, healing undead or damaging a living creature.

spells.name: Touch of Undeath
spells.notes: You attack the target's life force with undeath, dealing 1d6 void damage.

spells.name: Toxic Cloud
spells.notes: A bank of poison fog rolls away from you.

spells.name: Tracing Bond
spells.notes: Keep tabs on an ally and signal if needed.

spells.name: Tracking Mayflies
spells.notes: Send magic-eating mayflies with a ranged Strike.

spells.name: Trade Death for Life
spells.notes: Your patron steals life from one of your enemies to grant it to another.

spells.name: Trade Items
spells.target: 1 item you’re holding and 1 item in another creature’s possession you can see, each no more than light Bulk
spells.notes: You magically swap an item you’re holding for another that someone else has.

spells.name: Transcribe Conflict
spells.notes: You cause a sheet of paper to appear in your hand, and a moment later a detailed description of a combat you experienced within the last hour is recorded on that sheet of paper in a language that you know of your choice.

spells.name: Transcribe Moment
spells.notes: You instantly create a small, permanent scroll that contains a magically precise written description of your current surroundings in every direction.

spells.name: Translate
spells.notes: Grant understanding of a language to one creature.

spells.name: Translocate
spells.notes: Teleport a moderate distance.

spells.name: Transmute Rock and Mud
spells.notes: Turn an area of rock into mud or vice versa.

spells.name: Travel by Turtle
spells.notes: You conjure an intelligent sea turtle, who agrees to carry you upon its shell on a water journey.

spells.name: Traveler's Transit
spells.notes: You add power to your muscles, allowing you to swim or climb walls with ease.

spells.name: Traveling Workshop
spells.notes: Your apparition guides you through complex procedures while using your magic to provide you with whatever tools you need.

spells.name: Tree of Life and Death
spells.notes: Conjure a tree that heals and a tree that harms onto the battlefield.

spells.name: Tree of Seasons
spells.notes: Grow a tree with four explosive seedpods.

spells.name: Tremor Signs
spells.notes: Send a sentence through stone.

spells.name: Tremorsense
spells.notes: Sense vibrations in the ground.

spells.name: Trickster's Feathers
spells.notes: You conjure four magic feathers, each with the potential to hold a single illusory guise.

spells.name: Trickster's Mirrors
spells.notes: You are surrounded by up to 3 mirrors that reflect twisted and distorted images of you, making it hard to tell where you actually are within your space and potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the mirrors instead.

spells.name: Trickster's Twin
spells.notes: You rarely settle for being in just one place.

spells.name: Trim the Blight
spells.notes: You create a cone of shimmering energy that attempts to banish the influence of invasive, supernatural blight, such as that found in Tanglebriar.
spells.source: Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight

spells.name: Triple Time
spells.notes: Your music sets a fast pace.

spells.name: True Target
spells.notes: Make multiple attacks against a creature especially accurate.

spells.name: Truesight
spells.notes: See through illusions and physical transformations.

spells.name: Truespeech
spells.notes: Let a creature understand and speak all languages.

spells.name: Turbulent Tide
spells.notes: You cause the sheath of water and the improvised weapon it surrounds to surge outward with stupendous force as you attack.

spells.name: Ulcerous Canker
spells.notes: Weeping sores open on the target as you expose it to decay, dealing 1d4 void damage and 1d4 poison damage plus 1 persistent bleed damage .

spells.name: Umbral Extraction
spells.notes: Attempt to steal a spell slot.

spells.name: Umbral Graft
spells.notes: Attempt to steal an active spell.

spells.name: Umbral Journey
spells.target: you and up to 10 willing creatures touched
spells.notes: Travel rapidly via the Netherworld.

spells.name: Umbral Mindtheft
spells.notes: You prepare to steal a broad field of knowledge from another creature, siphoning it from their mind and storing it in a pocket of the Shadow Plane connected to your own mind.

spells.name: Unblinking Flame Aura
spells.notes: You focus your sight inside and call on your inner fire to grant you warmth, steady your vision, and soothe your body.

spells.name: Unblinking Flame Emblem
spells.notes: You emblazon the target with a fiery sigil that projects your sight and your flame onto them, allowing you and your allies to track their movements and making it easier to hit them.

spells.name: Unblinking Flame Ignition
spells.notes: You feel the most alive when pushed into a corner, as the insights and vision granted by the flame stoke into overdrive.

spells.name: Unblinking Flame Revelation
spells.notes: Suppress illusions on your target.

spells.name: Unbounded Sphere
spells.notes: You magically desynchronize the current plane of existence, trapping creatures in an area that loops back on itself in the manner of an unbounded plane.

spells.name: Unbreaking Wave Advance
spells.notes: Unleash a blast of water to push back foes.

spells.name: Unbreaking Wave Barrier
spells.notes: You create a protective circle around yourself that repels your foes.

spells.name: Unbreaking Wave Containment
spells.notes: You wrap enemies in four strands of water.

spells.name: Unbreaking Wave Vapor
spells.notes: You're concealed against the triggering attack and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against it.

spells.name: Unbroken Panoply
spells.target: 1 broken weapon that is unattended or held by a willing creature
spells.notes: As tools of violence undone by violence, broken weapons contain potent symbolic magic that faydhaans often call upon when forming alliances.

spells.name: Uncontrollable Dance
spells.notes: Overcome a target with an allconsuming urge to dance.

spells.name: Uncover Device
spells.notes: Use electricity to reveal the intricacies of a device.

spells.name: Undeath's Blessing
spells.notes: You instill within a creature the touch of the grave.

spells.name: Under Sunless Skies
spells.notes: The sun goes dark across the entire area of the spell, manipulating your enemies and giving your allies great resilience.

spells.name: Undermine Reality
spells.notes: You lash a target with tendrils of shadow that steal some of its substance, making it quasi-real.

spells.name: Undertaker
spells.notes: You point your finger toward the target and whisper an epitaph that promises to grace their gravestone in the near future.

spells.name: Undertow
spells.notes: You create an area of water 20 feet deep.

spells.name: Undetectable Alignment
spells.notes: Make a creature or object appear neutral to alignment detection.

spells.name: Unexpected Transposition
spells.target: 1 creature other than the triggering enemy
spells.notes: React to switch places with a creature.

spells.name: Unexpected Windfall
spells.notes: Coins, trinkets carved from heavy stone, and other cumbersome treasures rain down upon a foe.

spells.name: Unfathomable Song
spells.notes: Song debilitates creatures in weird and powerful ways.

spells.name: Unfetter Eidolon
spells.notes: You loosen the link between yourself and your eidolon, allowing them to travel farther from you for a short period of time and aiding them against being immobilized .

spells.name: Unfettered Movement
spells.notes: Repel effects that would hold a creature in place.

spells.name: Unfettered Pack
spells.notes: Let creatures avoid environmental hindrances.

spells.name: Unfolding Wind Blitz
spells.notes: You blitz forward so quickly that you soar through the air, and nothing can react to you.

spells.name: Unfolding Wind Buffet
spells.notes: You surround your unarmed attacks with the speed and force of air.

spells.name: Unfolding Wind Crash
spells.notes: You jump up to 120 feet in any direction and then deal 18d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures within a 20-foot emanation after you land, with a basic Reflex save.

spells.name: Unfolding Wind Rush
spells.notes: Run across the wind.

spells.name: Unholy Army
spells.notes: Reaching out to the legions of the wicked, you call upon them for assistance.

spells.name: Unimpeded Stride
spells.notes: Divine grace ensure that nothing can keep you prisoner or hold you back.

spells.name: Unity
spells.target: each ally targeted by the triggering spell
spells.notes: You put up a united defense.

spells.name: Unravel Existence
spells.notes: Use reality to tear a creature apart.

spells.name: Unravel Knowledge
spells.notes: Your patron reaches into the target’s mind, plucking out their past training like pulling a thread from a cloth.

spells.name: Unraveling Blast
spells.notes: You unleash a small blast of potential that destroys one of a creature's possible futures, leaving them reeling.

spells.name: Unrelenting Gravity
spells.notes: Increase the gravity a creature feels.

spells.name: Unrelenting Observation
spells.target: 1 creature or object tracked and up to 5 other willing creatures
spells.notes: You and other creatures track a subject exactly using scrying.

spells.name: Unseasonable Squall
spells.notes: You issue a blast of sudden wind that ripples outward from the center of the burst.
spells.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

spells.name: Unsettling Knowledge
spells.notes: You share a piece of hidden knowledge with a creature that is both upsetting and intriguing.

spells.name: Unsettling Perspective
spells.notes: You reach into a creature’s mind and give them a glimpse of their place in the universe, learning how they perceive their position within society while damaging their mind with the truth of their insignificance relative to all of existence.

spells.name: Unspeakable Shadow
spells.notes: Transform a creature's shadow into a frightening monster and make them flee or fight it.

spells.name: Untamed Form
spells.notes: You reach within for a different part of yourself, and you set it free, transforming your body into another form.

spells.name: Untamed Shift
spells.notes: You transform just a part of your body.

spells.name: Untwisting Iron Augmentation
spells.notes: Your unarmed attacks are treated as cold iron and silver , they gain the earth trait, and they gain a +1 status bonus to damage rolls per damage die.

spells.name: Untwisting Iron Buffer
spells.notes: Gain temporary hit points.

spells.name: Untwisting Iron Pillar
spells.notes: You call upon the earth and your ki to shield you from your enemies.

spells.name: Untwisting Iron Roots
spells.notes: You manipulate the earth beneath your feet to throw your enemies off balance, leaving chunks of rock and rubble behind.

spells.name: Unusual Anatomy
spells.notes: You transform your flesh and organs into a bizarre amalgam of glistening skin, rough scales, tufts of hair, and tumorous protuberances.

spells.name: Updraft
spells.notes: A powerful blast of wind erupts from the ground, launching the target into the air and sending it crashing back down.
spells.source: Rage of Elements, Secrets of Magic

spells.name: Upheaval
spells.notes: The ground in the area shudders and crumbles as huge pillars of stone erupt into the air, rending the terrain around them.

spells.name: Uplifting Overture
spells.notes: Your performance makes allies feel they can succeed at anything.

spells.name: Utter Destruction
spells.notes: You screech with an unearthly voice made of destructive energy, smashing everything that lies before you.

spells.name: Vacuum
spells.notes: Inhale to steal breath from creatures around you.

spells.name: Valiant Anthem
spells.notes: You chant a rallying cry to bolster your allies.

spells.name: Vampiric Exsanguination
spells.notes: Draw blood and life force from creatures in a cone, harming them and healing yourself.

spells.name: Vampiric Feast
spells.notes: Deal void damage and gain temporary Hit Points with a touch.

spells.name: Vampiric Maiden
spells.notes: An iron maiden steals a creature’s vitality.

spells.name: Vampiric Revelry
spells.notes: Steal the life of your enemies and perhaps share some with your allies.

spells.name: Vanish Weapon
spells.notes: Disarm with an extradimensional hole.

spells.name: Vanishing Tracks
spells.notes: Obscure your tracks.

spells.name: Vapor Form
spells.notes: Transform your body into vapor.

spells.name: Variable Gravity
spells.notes: Adjust gravity's grip between high, low, and normal gravity.

spells.name: Vector Screen
spells.notes: You set up a transparent, rippling screen of telekinetic energy that seizes small, fast-moving projectiles

spells.name: Veil of Broken Reality
spells.notes: All events that took place within the area are wiped from the memories of all creatures everywhere (including yourself and other excluded creatures), all records of the events are erased, and all attempts to receive any information about the events are automatically negated.

spells.name: Veil of Confidence
spells.notes: You surround yourself in confidence.

spells.name: Veil of Dreams
spells.notes: Your patron draws the target into a drowsy state, causing daydreams and sluggishness.

spells.name: Veil of Privacy
spells.notes: Protect a creature or object from magical detection.

spells.name: Veil Of Spirits
spells.notes: You draw on the essence of spiritual energy surrounding you to manifest a misty veil.

spells.name: Vengeful Glare
spells.notes: Your gaze falls on a creature, filled with icy vengeance or fiery wrath

spells.name: Ventriloquism
spells.notes: Throw your voice.

spells.name: Verdant Sprout
spells.notes: Make a plant seed grow rapidly.
spells.source: Rage of Elements, Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

spells.name: Verminous Lure
spells.notes: Upon casting, the target emits a musk that's captivating to certain animals.

spells.name: Vibrant Pattern
spells.notes: Make a pattern of lights that dazzles and blinds creatures who enter the area.

spells.name: Vibrant Thorns
spells.notes: Your body sprouts brambly thorns that thrive on life magic.

spells.name: Vibrant Vibrato
spells.notes: Your voice trills in perfect vibrato.

spells.name: Vicious Howl
spells.notes: You howl with passion for your cause, empowering yourself to push beyond your limits.

spells.name: Vicious Jealousy
spells.notes: The target is overcome by deep jealousy and resentment that twists its mind against other creatures.

spells.name: Victory Cry
spells.notes: Your true might comes from your bonds with your allies, and you glory in their achievements.

spells.name: Vindicator's Judgement
spells.notes: You pronounce a terrible judgment upon your quarry that causes all of your attacks and divine spells to strike with deadly efficacy.

spells.name: Vindicator's Mark
spells.notes: You launch a magical dart at your hunted prey, which marks them with a nimbus only you can detect.

spells.name: Vision of Beauty
spells.notes: You create a phantasmal image of the most beautiful creature imaginable to the target at a location somewhere within the spell's range.

spells.name: Vision of Death
spells.notes: Show the target a vision of their own death, causing fear and mental damage.

spells.name: Vision of Weakness
spells.notes: You focus your gaze on a creature and gain a flash of divine insight into its nature.

spells.name: Visions of Danger
spells.notes: A vision of a swarm deals mental damage.

spells.name: Vital Beacon
spells.notes: Radiate vitality that heals creatures that touch you.

spells.name: Vital Luminance
spells.notes: Drawing life force into yourself, you become a beacon of vitality.

spells.name: Vital Seed
spells.notes: Plant a seed in a creature that drains the life of those nearby to heal the target.

spells.name: Vitality Lash
spells.target: 1 creature that is undead or otherwise has void healing
spells.notes: Damage and weaken the undead with vital energy.

spells.name: Vitrifying Blast
spells.notes: Glass shards cut creatures and turn them glass-like.

spells.name: Voice on the Breeze
spells.notes: Whisper a message far away.

spells.name: Void Warp
spells.notes: Damage and weaken the living with void energy.

spells.name: Volcanic Eruption
spells.notes: Cause massive lava sprays that burn creatures and encase them in rock.

spells.name: Vomit Swarm
spells.notes: Vermin erupt in a cone from your mouth.

spells.name: Voracious Gestalt
spells.notes: Create a spirit gestalt that eats souls and grows stronger.

spells.name: Wails of the Damned
spells.notes: Scream, draining the living and causing void damage.

spells.name: Waking Dream
spells.notes: You cloud the target's mind with vivid, dreamlike imagery, so they have difficulty distinguishing real threats from imagined ones.

spells.name: Waking Nightmare
spells.notes: You fill the creature's mind with a terrifying vision.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.notes: Create a blazing wall that burns creatures that pass through.

spells.name: Wall of Flesh
spells.notes: Spawn a wall of living flesh.

spells.name: Wall of Force
spells.notes: Create an invisible and durable plane of magical force.

spells.name: Wall of Ice
spells.notes: Sculpt a foot-thick wall of ice that blocks sight and can chill creatures.

spells.name: Wall of Metal
spells.notes: Shape a wall made of a particular metal.

spells.name: Wall of Mirrors
spells.notes: You create a solid wall of shimmering reflective glass up to 50 feet long and 20 feet high.

spells.name: Wall of Radiance
spells.notes: You create a thin wall of brilliant light in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high.

spells.name: Wall of Shadow
spells.notes: You form a wall of pure darkness in a straight line up to 60 feet long and 10 feet high.

spells.name: Wall of Shrubs
spells.notes: Create a wall of shrubs that provide cover.

spells.name: Wall of Stone
spells.notes: Shape a wall of stone.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.notes: Grow a wall of brambles.

spells.name: Wall of Virtue
spells.notes: You create a translucent wall of light, which draws power from the celestial realms.

spells.name: Wall of Water
spells.notes: Create a wall of water, forcing foes to swim through.

spells.name: Wall of Wind
spells.notes: Create a wall of gusting winds that hinders movement and ranged attacks.

spells.name: Wanderer’s Guide
spells.notes: Find an ideal route to a location.

spells.name: Warding Aggression
spells.notes: Strike an enemy to improve your defense against it, and extend the spell with further attacks.

spells.name: Warning Stripes
spells.notes: Your skin becomes painted with vivid stripes or bright aposematic swirls, warning other creatures of its toxic qualities.

spells.name: Warp Mind
spells.notes: Confuse a creature, possibly permanently.

spells.name: Warp Step
spells.notes: When you walk, the earth warps beneath your feet—your steps extend, distance contracts, and everything is just a little bit closer.

spells.name: Warped Terrain
spells.notes: You create illusory hazards that cover all surfaces in the area.

spells.name: Warping Pull
spells.target: 1 willing creature that would take damage from the triggering effect
spells.notes: You get an ally out of danger with a teleporting pull.

spells.name: Warrior's Regret
spells.notes: Regrets overcome a foe if they harm others.

spells.name: Warshard Shot
spells.notes: Launch a piece of metal imbued with the spirit of the dead war god.

spells.name: Wash Your Luck
spells.notes: Ignore misfortune once.

spells.name: Watchdog
spells.notes: Have your companion guard a location.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.notes: Allow creatures to breathe underwater.

spells.name: Water Walk
spells.notes: Buoy a creature so it can walk on water.

spells.name: Waterproof
spells.notes: Protect an object against becoming wet.

spells.name: Wave of Despair
spells.notes: Drive creatures in an area to despair.

spells.name: Weaken Earth
spells.target: 1 creature, unattended object, or hazard or structure made of stone or earth
spells.notes: Reduce the durability of something made of earth.

spells.name: Weapon of Judgment
spells.notes: Form a divine weapon of war or peace.

spells.name: Weapon Storm
spells.notes: Multiply a weapon you hold and attack many creatures with it.

spells.name: Weapon Surge
spells.notes: Holding your weapon aloft, you fill it with divine energy.

spells.name: Weapon Tide
spells.notes: Conjure a wave of dangerous weapons.

spells.name: Weapon Trance
spells.notes: The serenity of violence fills your mind, giving you a heightened sense of knowing exactly where your weapons need to be.

spells.name: Weaponize Secret
spells.notes: You understand that holding a secret is in itself a kind of power.

spells.name: Weave Wood
spells.target: 1 piece of unprocessed wood, reeds, or plant fiber of 1 Bulk or less
spells.notes: Break plant fiber into strands and magically weave them.

spells.name: Web
spells.notes: Form a web that keeps creatures from moving.

spells.name: Web of Eyes
spells.notes: Put scrying sensors on creatures, allowing them to share their vision with others.

spells.name: Web of Influence
spells.notes: You learn the location of the nearest creature to whom the target is connected in a magical manner.

spells.name: Weight of the World
spells.notes: Crush a creature with intense force.

spells.name: Whirling Flames
spells.notes: You call forth a storm of whirling flames, engulfing all creatures in that area and dealing 5d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.

spells.name: Whirling Scarves
spells.notes: You surround yourself in a vortex of whirling colorful scarves of force that obfuscate you and disorient your foes.

spells.name: Whirlpool
spells.notes: Create a vortex of waves.

spells.name: Whirlwind
spells.notes: Create a moving tornado to damage creatures and raise them into the air.

spells.name: Whispering Quiet
spells.notes: You suppress sound in an area, preventing anyone from giving away valuable secrets.

spells.name: Whispers of a Dead Goddess
spells.notes: The mysterious whispers that fill the Mordant Spire, which some believe to be the voice of the dead goddess Acavna , become audible.

spells.name: Whispers of the Void
spells.notes: Drain creatures’ vigor with void energy.

spells.name: Widow's Bite
spells.notes: Inject a creature with a dangerous poison.

spells.name: Wild Winds Stance
spells.notes: You take on the stance of the flowing winds, sending out waves of energy at a distance.

spells.name: Wildfire
spells.notes: A thin layer of ash and flame covers the ground in the area.
spells.source: Rage of Elements, Secrets of Magic

spells.name: Wilding Word
spells.notes: Your patron's majesty—or their displeasure—comes in a growl from your throat, making other creatures reluctant to harm you.

spells.name: Wind Jump
spells.notes: You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

spells.name: Wind Whispers
spells.notes: You call forth numerous breezes in which you weave gossip, whispering subtly into the ears of those around.

spells.name: Wings of the Valkyrie
spells.notes: Powerful feathered wings—usually vibrant white or jet black— emerge from your back, granting you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

spells.name: Winning Streak
spells.notes: Quicken a target and make its critical hits spread the quickness.

spells.name: Winter Bolt
spells.notes: You fling a hollow icicle filled with winter’s wrath.

spells.name: Wisdom of the Winds
spells.notes: Ask air spirits for guidance.

spells.name: Wish Market
spells.notes: You signal your willingness to make a deal, attracting ghostly merchants that eagerly and silently wave contracts for your consideration while demanding an esoteric price.

spells.name: Wish-Twisted Form
spells.notes: You focus your magic upon an enemy, wishing for their defenses to fail and turning their strengths into weaknesses.

spells.name: With Friends Like These
spells.notes: You create a subtle dissonance between creatures, driving them apart. Each target must attempt a Will save.

spells.name: Withering Grasp
spells.notes: Your touch rots organic material and decays objects.

spells.name: Wood Walk
spells.notes: Wood shapes itself according to your will readily, making staircases appear as you climb up the side of a tree, automatically weaving vines into ladders, or lowering branches to lift you up to the top.

spells.name: Wooden Double
spells.notes: React to leave a wooden double of yourself to take a hit for you.

spells.name: Wooden Fists
spells.notes: Turn your hands into tree trunks.

spells.name: Word of Freedom
spells.notes: You utter a liberating word of power that frees a creature.

spells.name: Word of Revision
spells.notes: As all good writers know, you shouldn't kill off your protagonist before their story is complete.

spells.name: Word of Truth
spells.notes: You speak a statement that you believe to be true and that is free of any attempt to deceive through twisting words, omission, and so on.

spells.name: Wordsmith
spells.target: 1 document written by a single author and comprised of written text in a single language
spells.notes: You're a devotee of knowledge with an unmatched command of the language used to spread that knowledge.

spells.name: Worm's Repast
spells.notes: Gnawing worms materialize within the flesh of the target creature.

spells.name: Wrathful Storm
spells.notes: Create and control a massive storm.

spells.name: Wronged Monk's Wrath
spells.notes: You unleash your ki as a powerful storm of force and lightning.

spells.name: Wyvern Sting
spells.notes: You duplicate the venomous sting of a wyvern.
spells.source: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

spells.name: Ymeri's Mark
spells.notes: Curse a creature with the Queen of the Inferno’s mark to track it or make it explode.

spells.name: You're Mine
spells.notes: You manipulate the target's emotions, potentially allowing you to control it for a brief instant.

spells.name: Zeal for Battle
spells.notes: You stoke the righteous anger within yourself and an ally.

spells.name: Zealous Conviction
spells.notes: Instill unshakable conviction and zeal in willing creatures.

spells.name: Zenith Star
spells.notes: You call a tiny star to orbit a creature in a sparkling halo before shooting up into the heavens, where it marks the creature’s rough location.

spells.name: Zephyr Slip
spells.notes: React to fly away from a creature.

spells.name: Zero Gravity
spells.notes: Remove gravity in an area.

spells.name: Zombie Horde
spells.notes: You create a horde of nearly endless, but temporary, zombies.
